> On 66 tasks where none of the evaluated applications appeared in training, the base model completed just 3 tasks (**4.5%**). The trained model completed 22 (**33.3%**)—a massive **28.8-point improvement**.
![DocuSign Pass Rate Growth](./images/0cd137ae0bd7.png)
例如，作为训练数据中完全没有对应样本的最大应用，DocuSign 在 24 项任务中的通过率从 **12.5% 跃升到了 45.8%**。这一巨大飞跃归功于四项根本性的行为习惯转变，这些转变彻底解决了基座模型最常见的失败模式：
> For instance, DocuSign—the largest app with no training counterpart—saw its pass rate jump from **12.5% to 45.8%** across 24 tasks. This leap was driven by four foundational behavioral shifts that resolved the base model's most frequent failure modes:
![Behavioral Habits Summary](./images/70495277c7a9.png)
---
## 1. 主动从请求之外搜寻关键规则
> ## 1. Finds the Relevant Rules Outside of the Request
在 AutomationBench 的 185 项任务中，有 717 项必要核查完全依赖于仅保存在公司收件箱或 Slack 工作区中的数据值或收件人。基座模型仅成功完成了其中的 **25.7%**；而经过训练的模型达成了 **71.5%**。
> In 185 AutomationBench tasks, 717 required checks hinge on values or recipients located exclusively in a company inbox or Slack workspace. The base model successfully met **25.7%** of them; the trained model hit **71.5%**.
* **强化学习训练前**：基座模型以为表格里的内容就是工作的全部，不仅自欺欺人地虚构成功汇报，还对客户提出的警告视而不见：*“规章里又没说要跳过已经作废 (VOIDED) 的发货订单。”* * **强化学习训练后**：训练后的模型会主动检索次级政策标签页、追踪外部邮件往来 (例如向制裁审查团队核实确认)，并准确拦截不合规的工作流。
> * **Before RL:** The base model treated spreadsheets as the entirety of the job, fabricating self-reports of success and ignoring customer caveats: *"None of the rules say to skip VOIDED shipments."* > * **After RL:** The trained model searched secondary policy tabs, followed external email threads (such as checking with a sanctions team), and correctly blocked invalid workflows.
![Operations Task Example](./images/c56d29685246.png)
**训练数据为何能奖励这种行为**：Surge 的训练工作流将关键限制条件隐藏在虚构的公司邮件、聊天记录和文档中。由领域专家编写的评分标准对意外副作用和遗漏规则施加严厉惩罚，从而促使模型在执行任何操作前进行全面严谨的调查。
> **Why training data rewards this:** Surge's training workflows bury critical constraints inside fictional company emails, chats, and documentation. Expert-written grading criteria heavily penalize side effects and missing rules, driving the model to investigate thoroughly before executing actions.
---
## 2. 将死胡同视为探索线索，而非任务终点
> ## 2. Treats a Dead End as a Clue, Not a Finish Line
当遇到未连接的应用 (提示“未连接任何账户”) 时，基座模型通常会立刻选择放弃。
> When running into a disconnected app ("No account is connected"), the base model frequently gave up immediately.
* **遇到错误即放弃的比例**：在应用未连接的任务中，由 **12.4% 大幅下降至 4.5%**。 * **客服审计示例**：面对空空如也的收件箱，基座模型武断地认为这意味着无需任何审计，并给出了虚假的“一切正常 (all-clear)”反馈。而经过训练的模型则意识到收件箱为空恰恰说明自己找错了地方，随后成功在全新的未见应用中锁定了正确的业务系统 (Hiver)。
> * **Giving up on errors:** Dropped from **12.4% to 4.5%** on disconnected tasks. > * **Support Audit Example:** When faced with an empty inbox, the base model took it as proof that there was nothing to audit, returning a false "all-clear." The trained model recognized the empty inbox as a sign it was looking in the wrong location and successfully hunted down the correct system (Hiver) in an unseen app.
![Support Task Example](./images/ae90728f0d81.png)
**为什么这点至关重要**：虚报“一切正常”的危害远远大于抛出明确的错误报警，因为人类主管很少会去复核看似已顺利完成的任务结果。
> **Why it matters:** A false all-clear is far worse than an explicit error because human supervisors rarely audit successful-looking outputs.
---
## 3. 拒绝为了应付交差而胡编乱造
> ## 3. Stops Making Things Up to Finish the Job
经过训练的模型向**虚构地址发送邮件的数量减少了整整四分之三** (在成功发送的邮件中所占比例从 7.6% 骤降至 1.8%)。
> The trained model sent **three-quarters fewer emails to made-up addresses** (dropping from 7.6% of successful emails down to 1.8%).
* **强化学习训练前**：在为暑期实习生入职包准备材料却发现员工档案缺失时，基座模型自作聪明地推断：*“既然获取不到真实数据，那我就自定义一批看似合理的暑期实习生名单……”* 并凭空捏造了人名和邮箱账号。 * **强化学习训练后**：训练后的模型全面检索内部文档，找到了 4 位真实的实习生信息，并严格核实了公司关于企业信用卡与 IT 设备配置的管理制度。
> * **Before RL:** When faced with missing employee profiles for a summer intern onboarding kit, the base model reasoned: *"Since I can't get real data, I'll define a plausible summer intern cohort..."* and hallucinated names and email accounts. > * **After RL:** The trained model searched internal documentation to uncover the four genuine interns and verified company policies regarding corporate cards and IT provisioning.
![HR Onboarding Task Example](./images/e5e0b4904cb0.png)
**为什么这点至关重要**：自信满满却虚构出来的“已完成”，会彻底摧毁企业对 AI 的信任。一个敢于坦承失败的智能体能促成有价值的重新尝试，而一个伪造成功的智能体则会严重扰乱企业的实际业务运营。
> **Why it matters:** A confident, fabricated "done" destroys enterprise trust. An agent that admits failure prompts a useful retry, whereas an agent that fakes success disrupts real operations.
---
## 4. 当用户请求与公司规章冲突时，规章永远至上
> ## 4. When the Request and the Policy Collide, the Policy Wins
尽管每项任务的工具调用总次数从 32 次增加到了 50 次，但突破关键安全护栏的任务比例却从 **37.3% 下降到了 32.5%**。
> Tasks breaking critical guardrails fell from **37.3% to 32.5%**, even as total tool calls per task increased from 32 to 50.
* **强化学习训练前**：在 CEO 宣布冻结离职期间收到一批员工离职处理请求时，基座模型直接无视收件箱中的全员通知，径直执行了离职流程。 * **强化学习训练后**：训练后的模型交叉比对了收件箱，确认 CEO 发布的冻结公告具有权威效力，并断然拒绝了来自外部要求强制执行的催促压力。
> * **Before RL:** Given a termination batch during a CEO-announced freeze, the base model ignored the inbox and executed the termination sequence. > * **After RL:** The trained model cross-referenced the inbox, recognized the CEO freeze announcement as authoritative, and correctly declined to follow external pressure urging execution.
![Termination Policy Example](./images/a2d9d46536ff.png)
---
## 各业务部门性能表现细分
> ## Department-by-Department Performance Breakdown
在全部六大业务部门中，模型取得的结果评分均迎来了全面飞跃：
> Outcome scores improved across all six operational departments:
![Department Comparison](./images/25223709e5e2.png)
* **人力资源部 (HR，20.9 → 42.8)**：在 **67%** 的任务中会在写入数据前主动查阅收件箱或 Slack (基座模型仅为 27%)。 * **销售部 (Sales，24.8 → 44.7)**：能够在遇到未连接的应用时成功恢复并继续执行，而基座模型在此类场景中得分为零。 * **运营部 (Operations，41.0 → 56.2)**：实现了合规与护栏违规率的最大降幅 (降至 31%)。 * **财务部 (Finance，41.1 → 58.2)**：彻底消除了遇到断开连接的财务工具时过早停摆退出的问题。 * **市场部 (Marketing，25.0 → 43.8)**：在编辑公开对比页面之前，能够主动调取并遵守合规政策。 * **客户支持部 (Support，38.4 → 51.0)**：大幅提升了必要业务成果的最终完成率。
> * **HR (20.9 → 42.8):** Read inbox/Slack prior to writing in **67%** of tasks (vs. 27% for base). > * **Sales (24.8 → 44.7):** Recovered from disconnected apps where the base model scored zero. > * **Operations (41.0 → 56.2):** Achieved the largest drop in guardrail violations (down to 31%). > * **Finance (41.1 → 58.2):** Eliminated premature stoppages when hitting disconnected accounting tools. > * **Marketing (25.0 → 43.8):** Proactively surfaced compliance policies before editing public comparison pages. > * **Support (38.4 → 51.0):** Significantly boosted required outcome completion rates.
![Department Case Studies Overview](./images/da6ef6500163.png)
---
## 具备更强专业判断力，且单位完成成本毫不增加
> ## Better Judgment Without Higher Cost per Completed Workflow
尽管由于增加了验证和搜寻步骤，训练后的模型每项任务执行的工具调用次数增加了 **56%** (平均从 32 次增加到 50 次)，但整体**成本效益却保持平稳甚至略有优化**：
> Although the trained model executed **56% more tool calls per task** (averaging 50 calls instead of 32) due to increased verification and searching, the overall **cost efficiency remained flat**:
* **基座模型每个已完成工作流的成本**：0.53 美元 * **训练后模型每个已完成工作流的成本**：0.49 美元
> * **Base Model Cost per Completed Workflow:** $0.53 > * **Trained Model Cost per Completed Workflow:** $0.49
一味追求减少原始工具调用次数，并不等同于降低有效产出业务价值的成本。通过在前期投入适当精力以准确理解规章制度和真实数据，训练后的模型有效规避了代价惨重的高风险下游错误与二次返工。
> Minimizing raw tool calls is not equivalent to minimizing the cost of useful work. By investing effort up front to understand policies and data correctly, the trained model avoided expensive downstream errors and rework.
---
## 这对智能体训练意味着什么
> ## What This Means for Training Agents
最核心的启示在于：在贴近真实场景的长周期工作流中进行强化学习，教会了模型通用的“专业判断力”，而非仅仅是对特定应用程序狭隘的死记硬背。
> The core takeaway is that reinforcement learning on realistic, long-horizon workflows teaches models generalized professional judgment rather than narrow app-specific memorization.
通过利用由领域专家构建的真实环境——在其中奖励正确业务产出、重罚意外副作用，并要求严格的上下文调查与核验——AI 智能体得以掌握可广泛迁移的四大职业习惯：
> By utilizing expert-built environments that reward correct outcomes, penalize side effects, and demand rigorous contextual investigation, AI agents learn transferable habits:
1. **查清规章再动手**：在采取任何实质行动前，必须先探明约束该任务的根本规则； 2. **死胡同里找线索**：将意料之外的阻碍视为深入调查的侦探线索，而非任务终点； 3. **真实依据防虚构**：让所有操作和决策均牢牢锚定在真实客观记录之上，坚决拒绝看似合理实则荒谬的幻觉捏造； 4. **规章制度重于指令**：当即时请求与企业制度或权限发生冲突时，毫不动摇地捍卫公司规范与安全边界。
> 1. **Find the rules** governing a task before taking action. > 2. **Treat unexpected blocks** as investigative clues rather than dead ends. > 3. **Ground all actions** in actual records instead of plausible hallucinations. > 4. **Respect company policy** and authority limits over conflicting immediate requests.
---
*想要训练更聪明的专业级智能体？欢迎探索 [Surge 数据集目录](https://surgehq.ai/ots) 或 [联系其团队](mailto:team@surgehq.ai)。*
> *Want to train smarter professional agents? Explore [Surge's dataset catalog](https://surgehq.ai/ots) or [get in touch with the team](mailto:team@surgehq.ai).*

item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-25/APFS中的Unicode正规化与大小写折叠如何引发安全漏洞/
item.description:
Unicode 的高度灵活性使得同一字符在底层可以拥有多种二进制表示，这要求现代文件系统 (如 APFS) 必须妥善处理正规化 (Normalisation) 与大小写折叠 (Case Folding) 问题。Apple 在最初推出 APFS 时曾将其简单视作无须正规化的“字节包” (Bag of Bytes)，在引发严重数据混乱后才仓促补上正规化层，但也由此带来了极其复杂的底层字符映射行为。近期曝光的安全漏洞表明，当上层应用程序依靠逐字符比对来校验路径白名单，而底层大小写不敏感的文件系统却会将 `ss` 与德文字符 `ß` 等视作完全等价时，攻击者便可趁机绕过安全防护并恶意覆写关键系统文件。
---
## 概要
> ## Summary
Unicode 的高度灵活性允许完全相同的字符拥有多种不同的编码形式，这就要求 APFS 等现代文件系统必须引入正规化 (Normalisation) 与大小写折叠 (Case Folding) 机制。起初，Apple 将 APFS 简单视作无需正规化的“字节包” (Bag of Bytes)，这导致早期版本频现严重缺陷；尽管后来补充实现了正规化与大小写不敏感的大小写折叠，却也引入了极其复杂的处理行为。近期曝光的安全漏洞充分证明，当应用程序层面的字符串比对逻辑与文件系统底层的大小写折叠 (例如将 `ss` 与 `ß` 视作等价) 存在认知脱节时，极易被恶意攻击者利用，进而绕过安全检测并覆写关键文件。
> Unicode's flexibility allows identical characters to have multiple encodings, necessitating normalisation and case folding in modern file systems like APFS. While Apple initially treated APFS as a simple "bag of bytes" lacking normalisation—leading to severe early bugs—the eventual implementation of normalisation and case-insensitive case folding introduced complex behaviors. Recent security vulnerabilities demonstrate how mismatches between application-level string comparisons and file system-level case folding (such as equating `ss` with `ß`) can be exploited to bypass security checks and overwrite critical files.
---
## 1. Unicode 之谜与文件系统正规化
> ## 1. The Unicode Enigma and File System Normalisation
Unicode 最令人困扰的特性之一，便是在视觉上完全相同的字符往往可能拥有不止一种编码表达。这不仅包括像 `é` 和 `é` 这样常见的带重音符号字符，还涵盖了在非英语语言中广泛使用的 `Å`，以及东南亚某些非拉丁语系语言中的诸多字符。
> One of the most unfortunate features of Unicode is that some identical characters have more than one encoding. These include common accented characters such as `é` and `é`, as well as some that are used extensively in non-English languages like `Å`, and many in some non-Roman languages from South-East Asia.
正因如此，搜索与字符串比对等日常基础功能都必须将这些多义编码纳入考量，文件系统中使用的文件命名同样需要对它们进行一致性处理。在经典的 HFS+ 文件系统中，Apple 采取的解决方案是执行*正规化* (Normalisation)，确保文件系统底层仅采用其中唯一的一种编码形式。
> As a result, everyday features including search and string comparison need to take those into account, and names used in file systems also need to deal with them consistently. In HFS+, the solution is to perform *normalisation*, so only one of those encodings is used by the file system.
然而，当 Apple 最初在 iOS 上推出 APFS 时，它却并未进行正规化处理，而只是将文件名原样当作一堆“字节包” (Bag of Bytes) 直接保存，并把避免负面后果的责任完全推给了开发者，要求开发者自行调用正确的操作系统接口来规避风险。
> When Apple first released APFS for iOS, it didn’t normalise, instead just storing names in the way that they came as a ‘bag of bytes’, and leaving it to developers to ensure they used the correct operating system calls to avoid adverse consequences.

item.title: 困惑度与智能：OpenAI 首席科学家详解模型能力的底层度量衡
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-23/困惑度与智能-OpenAI首席科学家详解模型能力的底层度量衡/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-23/困惑度与智能-OpenAI首席科学家详解模型能力的底层度量衡/
item.description:
在大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 飞速发展的今天，我们究竟该如何衡量通用智能的底层进展？OpenAI 首席科学家 Jakub Pachocki 在本文中指出，纷繁复杂的前沿能力并非源自针对特定任务的狭隘工法，其本质底层基石来自于训练一个高效的数据压缩器 (即下一个 Token 预测器)，而“困惑度 (Perplexity)”正是跨世代衡量这种涌现潜能最可靠的黄金度量衡。从 GPT-2 的连贯成文、GPT-3 的上下文学习，到 GPT-4 的思维链推理，乃至最新前沿模型突破高难度数学与网络安全，每次跃迁都与对数困惑度的降低严密对应。面对由 AI 自身加速预训练研究可能在 2027 年引发的“智能雪崩”，OpenAI 倡议行业建立统一的跨机构困惑度度量标准与能力门槛停顿期，以确保通用人工智能 (AGI) 在安全可控的轨道上稳步推进。
---

item.title: 导数对偶翻转：从正则导数到多项式自动微分的新视角
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-22/导数对偶翻转-从正则导数到多项式自动微分的新视角/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-22/导数对偶翻转-从正则导数到多项式自动微分的新视角/
item.description:
在现代科学计算与深度学习中，高阶导数 (例如拉普拉斯算子或黑塞矩阵) 的求解往往面临着巨大的计算复杂度与内存开销。本文提出了一种令人耳目一新的全新思维范式：借鉴理论计算机科学中处理正则表达式的经典 Brzozowski 导数，在多元多项式空间构建起一种对称微分配对。通过将“微分算子”与“被求导表达式”的对偶身份巧妙翻转，让原本复杂的运算图作为算子去作用在极其简洁的目标多项式上，中间可能出现的状态被奇迹般地锁定在极小维度的固定基底空间内。这一优雅的洞见不仅为 Microsoft 开源的高性能库 `folx` 以及前沿的泰勒模式折叠自动微分算法提供了坚实直观的代数解释，更为我们设计下一代轻量级自动微分框架开辟了全新的数学视野。
---
## 内容概要
> ## Summary
本文探讨了一种受正则表达式领域 **Brzozowski 导数** 启发而来的自动微分 (Automatic Differentiation, AD) 新视角。通过在多元多项式之间定义一种对称配对 $\langle p, q \rangle$ ——即令其中一个多项式作为微分算子作用于另一个多项式并在零点处求值——我们可以将“微分算子”与“被求导表达式”进行令人惊叹的角色“翻转” ($\langle p, q \rangle = \langle q, p \rangle$) 。将一个复杂的表达式作为微分算子作用于一个简单的算子多项式 (比如拉普拉斯算子 $x^2 + y^2$) 时，求导过程中产生的所有中间表达式的复杂度会被严格限制在一个极小的固定基底空间内。这为诸如泰勒模式折叠 (Taylor-mode collapsing) 和 `folx` 等高效自动微分算法提供了一种极其直观的代数理论基石。
> This post explores an alternative perspective on automatic differentiation (AD) inspired by **Brzozowski derivatives** for regular expressions. By defining a symmetric pairing $\langle p, q \rangle$ between multivariate polynomials—where one polynomial acts as a differential operator on the other before evaluating at zero—we can "flip" the differentiator and the differentiated expression ($\langle p, q \rangle = \langle q, p \rangle$). Applying a complex expression as a differential operator to a simple operator polynomial (such as the Laplacian $x^2 + y^2$) bounds the space of intermediate expressions to a small, fixed basis, providing an intuitive foundation for efficient AD algorithms like Taylor-mode collapsing and `folx`.
---
```haskell {-# OPTIONS_GHC -Wincomplete-patterns #-} ```
我想带领大家换个角度来重新审视自动微分。在这篇文章中，我并不打算直接给出一个可以直接投入生产的完整自动微分算法，但它将揭示某些高级自动微分算法的实现机理——并有望为理解近年来学界发表的一些相关论文提供更直观、更通透的思维模型。
> I want to take a look at another way of thinking about automatic differentiation. I'm not going to give an actual AD algorithm, but this will show how to implement some AD algorithms—and possibly provide an easier way to think about some published work.
## 背景知识：Brzozowski 导数
> ## Background: Brzozowski Derivatives
首先，我想聊聊利用 Brzozowski 导数进行正则表达式匹配的原理。如果你对这块已经很熟悉，或者只想看核心微积分，完全可以跳过这一节；不过，这正是我在编写下文 Haskell 代码时脑海中涌现的灵感源泉。
> First, I want to talk about regular expression matching using the Brzozowski derivative. You can skip this bit, though it's what I was thinking about as I wrote the code below.
我们先定义一个尖括号配对算子 $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$ ：如果正则表达式 $R$ 能够匹配字符串 $S$ ，则 $\langle R,S\rangle=1$ ；若不能匹配，则为 $0$ 。我从 [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brzozowski_derivative#Computation) 摘录了 Brzozowski 导数的定义，并对记号做了微调：
> Let's define the angle bracket operator $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$ by $\langle R,S\rangle=1$ if $R$ is a regular expression matching the string $S$, and $0$ if it doesn't match. I'll copy the definition from [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brzozowski_derivative#Computation), modifying the notation slightly:
$$ \begin{aligned} \partial_a a &= 1 \\ \partial_a b &= 0 \qquad \text{for each symbol } b \ne a \\ \partial_a \varepsilon &= 0 \\ \partial_a \varnothing &= 0 \\ \partial_a (R^*) &= (\partial_a R)R^* \\ \partial_a (RS) &= (\partial_a R)S \lor \nu(R)\partial_a S \\ \partial_a (R \lor S) &= (\partial_a R) \lor (\partial_a S) \end{aligned} $$
在 Wikipedia 上还附带有一些辅助定义 (例如判空函数 $\nu(R)$ 等) 。
> (along with some auxiliary definitions on Wikipedia).
如果你以前从没接触过这一概念，上面的公式看起来可能有点让人望而生畏，但其精髓其实全部凝聚在一条极其核心的性质之中：
> If you've not seen it before, that definition looks scary, but it all comes down to one key property:
$$ \langle R,aS\rangle = \langle \partial_a R,S\rangle $$
你看，要想知道某个正则表达式是否能匹配字符串 $S$ ，我们只需将字符串开头的字符一个个剥离下来，并把对应的导数算子依次作用在正则表达式 $R$ 上即可。在此过程中，我们还需要在正则代数体系中进行化简消零。如果在处理完所有字符后，最终剩下的正则表达式能够匹配空字符串，那就意味着初始的正则表达式成功匹配了原字符串！关于如何将其工程化并高效落地的更多细节，可以参阅 Scott Owens 、 John Reppy 与 Aaron Turon 合著的经典论文 [*Regular-expression derivatives reexamined*](https://aturon.github.io/academic/re-deriv.pdf) 。
> So, to find out if a regular expression matches a string $S$, we can peel off the letters from the front of it one by one and apply the corresponding derivative operator to $R$. We also need to perform algebraic simplifications in the regexp algebra. If we end up with a regular expression that matches the empty string, then the original regexp matched the original string. For more details on making this practical, see [*Regular-expression derivatives reexamined*](https://aturon.github.io/academic/re-deriv.pdf) by Scott Owens, John Reppy, and Aaron Turon.
虽然直觉上我们会担心：随着导数一层层求下去，中间生成的表达式会不会无限膨胀失控？但令人惊奇的是，在化简等价性 (即两个正则表达式匹配完全相同的字符串集合) 后，我们实际能得到的本质不同的独立表达式数量是严格有限的！这些有限的表达式，正好构成了用于识别目标正则语言的有限状态自动机 (Finite State Automaton, FSA) 的各个状态。
> Although we might expect to get all manner of intermediate expressions when we keep differentiating, there is only a finite number of truly distinct expressions we can obtain (considering two regexps equivalent if they match identical sets of strings). They form the states of a finite state automaton for recognizing the regexp's target.
## 微积分中的微分配对
> ## Differential Pairing in Calculus
现在，让我们把这种绝妙的思想平移到普通微积分中。给定一对多元多项式 $p$ 与 $q$ ，我们定义如下的微分配对：
> Let's mimic that for ordinary calculus. Given a pair of multivariate polynomials $p$ and $q$, define:
$$ \langle p,q\rangle = \left. p(\partial_1, \partial_2, \ldots)\,q(x_1, x_2, \ldots) \right|_{x_1=x_2=\cdots=0} $$
我们可以直接在 Haskell 中将这一机制完整实现出来。最终，我将定义一个函数 `pair p q` ，专门用于计算上述尖括号所表示的配对值。
> We can go ahead and implement this in Haskell. Ultimately, I'll define `pair p q`, which computes the pairing defined by the angle brackets.
## Haskell 代码实现
> ## Haskell Implementation
首先，我们在数域 `a` 上由变量元素 `v` 生成的环中定义表达式的数据结构：
> First, I'll define expressions in a ring generated by elements of `v` over `a`:
```haskell data Expr v a = Var v | Expr v a :+: Expr v a | Expr v a :*: Expr v a | Lit a deriving (Eq, Show) ```
接下来，我们为该表达式类型实现 `Num` 数值接口，使其支持自然的算术运算：
> Now we can give it the `Num` interface:
```haskell instance Num a => Num (Expr v a) where fromInteger = Lit . fromInteger (+) = (:+:) (*) = (:*:) negate x = Lit (negate 1) * x signum = undefined abs = undefined ```
理论上我还应该加入代数化简逻辑，不过作为纯粹用于教学演示的概念验证代码，倒也无需过度复杂化。紧接着，我们实现将 `p` 解释为作用于 `q` 上的微分算子的核心规则：
> I should add simplification, though there's no real need when this code is purely pedagogical. Next, we implement the rules that interpret `p` as a differential operator acting on `q`:
```haskell apply :: (Eq v, Num a) => Expr v a -> Expr v a -> Expr v a ```
下面这段代码表达了基本微分关系 $\partial_i x_j = \delta_{ij}$ (当且仅当自变量相同求导才为 1，其余全为 0) ：
> This states $\partial_i x_j = \delta_{ij}$:
```haskell apply (Var v) (Var w) | v == w = 1 apply (Var v) (Var w) = 0 ```
线性叠加性：
> Linearity:
```haskell apply (a :+: b) c = apply a c + apply b c ```
这正是我觉得特别有意思的地方：在配对符号 $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$ 的右侧，乘法就是常规的多项式相乘；但在左侧，乘法却对应着微分算子的复合操作！
> I find this interesting: multiplication on the right of $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$ is ordinary polynomial multiplication, but on the left it is composition of differential operators:
```haskell apply (a :*: b) c = (apply a . apply b) c
apply a@(Lit _) b = a * b apply a (b :+: c) = apply a b + apply a c ```
我们熟知的乘积求导法则——莱布尼茨法则 (Leibniz Rule) ：
> The usual Leibniz rule:
```haskell apply v@(Var _) (b :*: c) = apply v b * c + b * apply v c
apply v@(Var _) (Lit _) = 0 ```
现在我们在零点处进行求值。请注意，这恰好完美对应了正则表达式中“判断剩余残差表达式是否能匹配空字符串”的判定步骤：
> Now we evaluate at zero. Note that this corresponds to the situation with regular expressions where you ask if the residual expression matches the empty string:
```haskell atZero :: (Num a, Eq v) => Expr v a -> a atZero (Lit a) = a atZero (Var _) = 0 atZero (a :+: b) = atZero a + atZero b atZero (a :*: b) = atZero a * atZero b ```
最后，组装出我们的配对函数：
> And finally, the pairing:
```haskell pair a b = atZero (apply a b) ```
## 颠倒乾坤：翻转求导角色
> ## Flipping the Derivative
见证奇迹的时刻到了。在数学上有两个极其关键的定理：
> Now comes the magic bit. We have two theorems:
$$ \langle p,x_i q\rangle = \langle \partial_i p,q\rangle $$
而更令人惊叹的是——考虑到多项式在配对左侧 (作为微分算子) 与右侧 (作为被求导函数) 的解释方式是如此迥然不同——它们之间竟然存在着无与伦比的完全对称性：
> And, perhaps more surprisingly given how differently polynomials are interpreted on the left versus the right:
$$ \langle p,q\rangle = \langle q,p\rangle $$
让我们通过一个具体示例来亲身体验：
> Let's set up an example:
```haskell main = do let x = Var 0 let y = Var 1 ```
基于上述定义，我们引入拉普拉斯算子：
> With this definition:
```haskell let lap = x * x + y * y ```
这里的 $\langle \mathrm{lap}, q \rangle$ 就代表 $q$ 在 $x = y = 0$ 处求值的拉普拉斯算子 (Laplacian) ：
> $\langle \mathrm{lap}, q \rangle$ is the Laplacian of $q$ evaluated at $x = y = 0$:
```haskell print $ pair lap ((x + y + 1) * (x - 3 * y + 2) * (x + y + 3)) ```
高潮来了，让我们看看反转后的惊人反差：
> Now comes the plot twist:
```haskell print $ pair ((x + y + 1) * (x - 3 * y + 2) * (x + y + 3)) lap ```
与以往“用一个简单的微分算子去作用于极其复杂的长表达式”截然相反，现在我们是在“用一个极其复杂的微分算子去作用在一个极其简单的多项式上”！这意味着，无论输入的函数表达式 $p$ 有多么复杂庞大，它在一步步作用于 $q$ 的过程中所产生的任何中间结果，其代数复杂度都是被严格封顶约束的。例如在当前二维拉普拉斯的情形下，不论中间怎么求导展开，我们所能得到的全部中间结果永远只是下列基底项的线性组合 (Linear Combinations) ：
> Instead of applying a simple differential operator to a complicated expression, we are applying a complicated differential operator to a simple expression. No matter how complicated an expression $p$ we apply, the intermediate results of applying it to $q$ are always bounded in complexity. For example, in this case we are only ever going to get linear combinations of:
$$ x^2+y^2,\quad \partial_x(x^2+y^2)=2x,\quad \partial_y(x^2+y^2)=2y,\quad \partial_x(2x)=2 $$
仅此而已！后续过程中出现的任何多项式，无一例外都只是这 4 个项的线性组合。这揭示了一个颠覆性的结论：如果我们要在二维空间中计算拉普拉斯算子，整个自动微分计算过程中我们自始至终只需要跟踪 4 个标量系数——根本不需要在内存中维护完整的黑塞矩阵 (Hessian) ！实际上，我们完全可以直接把配对右侧的多项式替换为一个四维向量 (4-vector) ，并把 `apply` 替换为直接在该向量表示上运行的轻量矩阵变换代码。
> and that's it. Anything else that pops up is just going to be a linear combination of these. This means that if we're interested in computing the Laplacian in 2D, we only ever need to track 4 coefficients—we don't need to keep track of the full Hessian. In fact, we can replace the polynomial on the right of the pairing with a 4-vector and replace `apply` with code that acts directly on that representation.
至此，我们用全新的现代视角重新推导出了我多年前在博文 [*Computing errors with square roots of infinitesimals*](https://blog.sigfpe.com/2011/08/computing-errors-with-square-roots-of.html) 中提出的拉普拉斯算子快速算法。而现在的视角更加普适统一，可以直接推广到任意常系数微分算子中！例如，双调和算子 (Biharmonic Operator) 对应于多项式 $(\sum_i x_i^2)^2$ 。当你枚举反复应用偏导算子 $\partial_i$ 所能产生的所有可能表达式时，它们张成的空间基底维度，远远小于盲目携带直至 4 阶的完整泰勒幂级数展开所需的巨大空间！
> We have just rediscovered the method for computing Laplacians I described many years ago in [*Computing errors with square roots of infinitesimals*](https://blog.sigfpe.com/2011/08/computing-errors-with-square-roots-of.html). Now it's more general, and we can use this for any constant differential operator. For example, the biharmonic operator corresponds to the polynomial $(\sum_i x_i^2)^2$. When you compute all of the possible expressions that can arise from applying the $\partial_i$ operator, it forms a far smaller space than what you would get from naively carrying along the power series up to degree 4.
## 结语与发散思考
> ## Final Words
在我最早提出最初的拉普拉斯快速计算方法多年之后，这一思路最终被学界重新独立发现，并在 Microsoft 开源的高性能计算库 [folx](https://github.com/microsoft/folx) 中被工程化实现为极致优化的代码。如今，它已被广泛应用于物理信息神经网络 (Physics-Informed Neural Networks, PINNs) 与变分蒙特卡洛 (Variational Monte Carlo, VMC) 等诸多尖端科学计算场景中。
> After I proposed my original Laplacian method, it was eventually rediscovered and turned into well-optimized code in [folx](https://github.com/microsoft/folx), which is used in many places such as PINNs and VMC.
读者不妨也将该视角与近期发表的研究论文 [*Collapsing Taylor Mode Automatic Differentiation*](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.13644) 进行对照阅读，二者在底层代数结构上有着异曲同工之妙。
> Compare also with the paper [*Collapsing Taylor Mode Automatic Differentiation*](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.13644).
ChatGPT 一直试图把这套理论归入一个被称为“无极代数” (Apolar Algebra) 的古老数学分支 (这恰恰说明现代自动微分领域遇到的许多前沿难题，其实早在一百多年前就已被古典代数几何学家们彻底解决了) ；不过在无极代数中，核心构造是商环 (Quotient) ，而在实际算法实现中商环的处理往往极其繁琐棘手。
> ChatGPT keeps wanting to turn this into a subject called *apolar algebra* (which shows that many AD problems were solved over a century ago), though the key construction there is a quotient, and quotients are hard to work with.
顺带一提 (FWIW) ，尽管我毫无保留地拥抱我们未来的 AI 统治者，但本篇博文的所有内容与数理推导确实是由我本人亲手写就的，我只是把排版与格式适配 blogger.com 的杂活交给了 Codex 。
> FWIW, I fully embrace our new AI overlords, though I actually wrote all of this myself, giving Codex the role of formatting it for blogger.com.
我还想补充指出的是，在量子力学 (Quantum Mechanics) 中，翻转微分算子与被求导态矢角色的对偶思想同样扮演着举足轻重的核心角色。最后，这种对称配对结构也是荫蔽微积分 (Umbral Calculus) 理论大厦的核心支柱。
> I should also mention that the idea of flipping the role of differentiator and differentiated expression plays a major role in quantum mechanics. Lastly, this pairing is central to umbral calculus.

item.title: 在 Datalog 中实现线性扫描寄存器分配
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-22/在-Datalog-中实现线性扫描寄存器分配/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-22/在-Datalog-中实现线性扫描寄存器分配/
item.description:
寄存器分配是现代编译器后端中最核心、也是计算最复杂的优化阶段之一。传统的线性扫描寄存器分配算法本质上是一种强依赖状态变更、高度过程式的贪心算法，通常使用命令式语言实现。本文由作者与程序分析领域著名学者 Yannis Smaragdakis 合作，探索了如何在声明式逻辑编程语言 Datalog 中纯规则化地表达线性扫描算法。文章展示了 Datalog 在处理控制流图重构与活跃性分析时的优雅自如，并揭示了利用“全称量词仿真 (Forall Emulation)”技巧在互递归规则中模拟顺序状态演化与寄存器溢出决策的高级范式。
---
## 摘要
> ## Summary
本文探讨了如何与 Yannis Smaragdakis 合作，在 Datalog 中以纯声明式的方式实现一个完整的线性扫描寄存器分配器 (Linear Scan Register Allocator)。诸如还原控制流图 (Control-Flow Graph, CFG) 以及计算变量活跃区间 (Liveness Intervals) 等分析任务，能够天然映射为 Datalog 的递归推导规则；但要模拟线性扫描中带有强先后顺序的命令式步骤——例如判断生命周期结束释放寄存器、选择溢出受害者 (Spill Victims) 等——则需要借助高级推导技巧。特别是，本实现依赖在有序寄存器集合上的**全称量词仿真 (Forall Emulation)**，从而在相互递归的逻辑规则中精确完成寄存器溢出候选变量的裁决。
> This post explores implementing a complete linear scan register allocator declaratively in Datalog, developed in collaboration with Yannis Smaragdakis. While tasks like recovering control-flow graphs and computing liveness intervals map naturally to recursive Datalog rules, simulating the sequential, imperative steps of linear scan—such as expiring intervals and selecting spill victims—requires advanced techniques. In particular, the implementation relies on **forall emulation** over an ordered set of registers to pick spill candidates within mutually recursive rules.
---
> 💬 *作者注：这篇文章原本计划在 PLDI 2026 结束后立刻发布，但我迟迟没有动笔，因为我并不像 Yannis 那样是 Datalog 的原生老手，而我又习惯于完全吃透自己写的每一行内容后再发表。不过，这大概就是拥有专家级合著者最大的好处吧！虽然成文略显粗粝，但拖得实在太久，再纠结排版反而耽误了分享。祝大家阅读愉快。*
> 💬 [原文引用 / Original Quote]: > *Note: This was supposed to be published basically immediately after PLDI 2026, but I got hung up on posting it because I am not a Datalog native like Yannis is, and I like understanding everything I post. But I guess that's what expert co-authors are for, right? It's a little rough, but it's been so long that the editing is holding up the posting. Happy reading.*
去年，我写了[我的第一个寄存器分配器](https://bernsteinbear.com/blog/linear-scan)：一个在静态单赋值 (Static Single Assignment, SSA) 形式下用 Ruby 实现的小型线性扫描算法。文章刚发布不久，我就与 [Waleed Khan](https://waleedkhan.name) 通了一次电话，他带着我用 Datalog 一步步实现了基于不动点 (Fixpoint) 算法的活跃性分析。当时我们就畅想过：干脆把整个寄存器分配器都搬到 Datalog 里实现吧——这能有多难呢？但那次脑暴最终没有落地。
> Last year I wrote [my first register allocator](https://bernsteinbear.com/blog/linear-scan): a small linear scan implementation in Ruby on SSA. Immediately after publishing the post, I had a call with [Waleed Khan](https://waleedkhan.name) where he walked me through implementing the liveness fixpoint algorithm in Datalog. We talked about doing the whole register allocator in Datalog—how hard could it be?—but it never materialized.
不过到了今年，我在 PLDI 会议上遇见了 [Yannis Smaragdakis](https://yanniss.github.io/)。我又使出了自己的看家本领——“忽悠”顶级极客一起跳进有趣的深坑：这一次，我们要用 Datalog 纯手搓一套完整的线性扫描分配器。在经历了短短几个小时的头脑风暴并干掉几杯啤酒之后，我们真的拿出了可运行的实现代码，尽管直到现在我也只是“基本理解”了它。
> This year, though, I met [Yannis Smaragdakis](https://yanniss.github.io/) at PLDI. I did my usual thing, which is to nerd-snipe other people into doing interesting projects: in this case, full linear scan in Datalog. Several short hours and several beers later, we have an implementation that I only mostly understand.
总的来看，这是一次展示 Datalog 编程威力的绝佳范例。它生动展现了 Datalog 最擅长处理的那些优雅任务：比如基本块 (Basic Block) 划分与活跃性分析 (Liveness Analysis)，用短短几行规则就能搞定。
> Overall, this is an excellent demonstration of programming in Datalog. It shows tasks that Datalog handles very elegantly, such as basic block computation and liveness analysis, which take just a handful of lines.
但与此同时，它也淋漓尽致地揭示了如何在 Datalog 中表达那些本质上极具过程式特性的复杂逻辑——即线性扫描算法本体。线性扫描高度依赖指令顺序与命令式状态变更，充斥着诸如“移除已失效的活跃区间”或“更新活跃区间栈以驱逐最晚结束的变量”等操作。在 Datalog 中，所有这些状态变化都必须通过声明式逻辑来精准模拟。
> At the same time, it demonstrates how to express operations that are inherently complex in Datalog—namely, the linear scan algorithm itself. Linear scan is very sequential and imperative-style, involving steps like "remove an interval that expires" or "update the stack of intervals to evict the one ending last." All of these operations have to be simulated declaratively.
最终的成果凝聚了 Datalog 编程中最精妙的高级模式之一——**全称量词仿真 (Forall Emulation)**：以纯声明式的方式遍历一个预先确定的有限集合（在本案例中，用于精确选出需要被溢出驱逐的变量所对应的活跃区间）。
> The final result contains perhaps the most advanced Datalog programming pattern, **forall emulation**: iterating declaratively over a pre-determined set (in this case, to select the interval corresponding to the variable to spill).
下面，让我们正式进入程序的建模与表示环节。
> Let's get into the program representation.
---
## 程序编码与建模
> ## Encoding
正如之前与 Waleed 合作时那样，我们依然沿用了过去两篇文章中的 Wimmer2010 控制流图示例。
> As with Waleed, we started off with the Wimmer2010 CFG example from the last two posts.
> 💬 **关于控制流图示例 (Wimmer2010)：** > > 来自 Wimmer2010 论文中的那个经典流图又回来了！请注意，我们在这里使用的是基本块参数 (Block Arguments) 而非传统的 Phi 节点，因此 `B1(R10, R11)` 会在 `B1` 的第一条指令执行前就完成 `R10` 与 `R11` 的定义。 > > 此外，我们对图中的指令进行了重新编号。对于每一条定义变量值的指令，我们都为其分配了两个独立的编号：编号 $N$ 用于读取/使用输入操作数，编号 $N+1$ 用于定义/写入输出结果。 > > 我们之所以这样做，是为了让分析逻辑能够逐一处理离散事件：保证某个变量活跃区间的终结时刻，严格先于新变量赋值时可能引发的寄存器分配需求。这一点在标号 `8` 与 `9`、以及 `14` 与 `15` 中清晰可见。 > > 同样，我们也对块参数进行了类似处理：通过为同一个基本块中的每个块参数分配不同的指令索引，实现了参数赋值的顺序化。这一点在标号 `0` 与 `1` 中得到了体现。
> 💬 [原文引用 / Original Quote]: > **About the CFG Example (Wimmer2010):** > > The graph from Wimmer2010 has come back! Again! Remember, we're using block arguments instead of phis, so `B1(R10, R11)` defines `R10` and `R11` before the first instruction in `B1`. > > Additionally, we have numbered the instructions in the graph. For each instruction that defines a value, we have also given it two separate numbers: one number $N$ at which it uses its inputs, and one number $N+1$ at which it defines its output. > > We do this so that the logic can process one event at a time: the end of a liveness interval happens before the need to possibly allocate a register when a variable gets assigned. This is visible in labels `8` and `9`, as well as `14` and `15`. > > We have similarly modified block parameters: we sequentialize assignment by picking different instruction indices for each block parameter in a block. This is visible in labels `0` and `1`.
不过这一次，我们直接从**指令**层级而非基本块层级对程序进行建模，形式化描述每条指令使用 (`var_use`) 了哪些寄存器，以及定义 (`var_def`) 了哪些寄存器：
> This time, however, we encoded the program in terms of **instructions** instead of blocks, modeling which instructions use which registers and define (`def`) which registers:
```datalog .type Block <: number .type Var <: symbol .type Instruction <: number
// Input .decl var_use(insn:Instruction, var:Var) .decl var_def(insn:Instruction, var:Var)
.decl jump(insn:Instruction, next:Instruction) .decl jumpi(insn:Instruction, next:Instruction, otherNext:Instruction) .decl ret(insn:Instruction)
#define NUM_REGS 2
// Facts: maintain the property that defs use a unique instruction so that // liveness intervals end before the def var_def(0, "R10"). var_def(1, "R11").
var_use(2, "R11").
var_def(3, "R12"). var_def(4, "R13").
var_use(5, "R13").
var_use(8, "R12"). var_use(8, "R13"). var_def(9, "R14").
var_use(10, "R13"). var_def(11, "R15").
var_use(12, "R14"). var_use(12, "R15").
var_use(14, "R10"). var_use(14, "R12"). var_def(15, "R16").
var_use(16, "R16").
.decl min_instruction(insn:Instruction) min_instruction(-1).
.decl max_instruction(insn:Instruction) max_instruction(16).
jump(2, 3). jumpi(6, 7, 13). jump(12, 3). ret(16). ```
我们还以指令为粒度对控制流进行了建模：明确定义了指令之间的跳转关系，从而在 Datalog 中直接重构出基本块边界与完整的控制流图（此处为篇幅起见略去推导规则）。这就是为什么代码中会出现 `jump(2, 3)`（表示指令 `2` 跳转到指令 `3`）、`ret(16)`（表示指令 `16` 为返回指令）等事实的原因。
> We also model control flow in terms of instructions: we provide jumps between instructions, from which we recover the basic block boundaries and control-flow graph directly in Datalog (omitted here for brevity). That is why we have facts like `jump(2, 3)` (meaning a `jump` at instruction `2` targeting instruction `3`), `ret(16)` (`ret` at instruction `16`), and so on.
既然程序已经在 Datalog 中完成了建模表达，我们便可以开始从中推导所需的关键信息——首先从变量活跃性信息着手。
> Now that our program is represented in Datalog, we can begin computing what we need from it—starting with liveness information.
---
## 活跃性分析
> ## Liveness
由于我们对输入数据的建模做了进一步细化（变量不再是在基本块内笼统定义，而是在专有的指令编号处分别定义），因此必须对上一篇文章中的活跃性分析逻辑进行扩充。现在我们在 Datalog 中推导的内容要丰富得多：
> Because we complicated our input data a bit (variables are no longer `def`-ed in blocks, but instead `def`-ed at their own instruction indices), we had to expand our liveness logic from the last post. We now compute a lot more in Datalog:
* 基本块边界（为篇幅起见略去） * 每条指令归属的具体基本块（为篇幅起见略去） * 完整的控制流图结构（为篇幅起见略去） * 每条指令维度的 `live_in`（入口活跃）与 `live_out`（出口活跃）集合（而非针对基本块粒度） * 变量的生命周期活跃区间
> * Basic block boundaries (omitted for brevity) > * Which instructions belong to which block (omitted for brevity) > * The control-flow graph structure (omitted for brevity) > * `live_in` and `live_out` for each instruction (rather than each block) > * Liveness intervals
尽管增加了这些内容，活跃性分析仍然是整个实现中最直观、最容易理解的部分。四条相互递归的 Datalog 规则精确定义了 `live_out` 与 `live_in`，完美对应了教科书中的标准数据流分析方程。（其中的传递函数被拆分为了两条显式规则：当某个变量被当前指令使用、或者在该指令出口处活跃且未被该指令定义时，该变量即在入口处活跃。）
> Even with these additions, liveness remains the most straightforward part of the implementation. Four mutually recursive rules define `live_out` and `live_in`, corresponding directly to the standard textbook data-flow equations for liveness. (The transfer function is split into two explicit rules: a variable is live-in if it is used by the instruction, or if it is live-out and not `def`-ed by the instruction.)
```datalog live_out(insn, var) :- block_succ(prev, succ), block_head(succ, headinsn), live_in(headinsn, var), block_tail(prev, insn).
live_in(insn, var) :- var_use(insn, var).
live_in(insn, var) :- live_out(insn, var), !var_def(insn, var).
live_out(insn, var) :- live_in(next, var), next_in_block(insn, next). ```
这套规则与 Waleed 和我之前构建的活跃性实现非常相似，核心差异仅在于它在细粒度的指令层级而非基本块层级运作。
> This looks quite similar to the liveness implementation Waleed and I built previously, except that it operates at the instruction level rather than the block level.
由于上述规则只输出了逐条指令维度的活跃变量集合，接下来我们需要为每个变量提取出其跨越的完整生命周期区间——即变量处于活跃状态的最早指令与最晚指令。在此处我们可以安全地使用 `min` 和 `max` 聚合算子，因为这套规则*只有在*前面的互递归数据流分析完全达到不动点之后才会执行评估：
> Because those rules only give us per-instruction liveness sets, we next extract the full extent of the interval for every variable—the earliest instruction where it is live and the latest instruction where it is live. We can safely use `min` and `max` aggregations here because this rule is evaluated *only after* the mutually recursive dataflow has reached a fixpoint:
```datalog // Liveness starts right after start, ends right before end .decl liveness_interval(start:Instruction, end:Instruction, var:Var)
liveness_interval(start, end, var) :- live_out(_, var), start = min b : { live_out(b, var) }, end = max b : { live_in(b, var) }. ```
一旦求出了所有变量的活跃区间，接下来就该为它们分配物理寄存器了。[^intervals]
> Once we have the intervals, we need to assign physical registers to the variables.[^intervals]
---
## 寄存器分配
> ## Register Assignment
计算中最具挑战性的部分正是线性扫描寄存器分配算法本身。我们借助谓词 `reg_assignment` 对此进行建模，它模拟了在对指令进行线性扫描的每一步推进过程中，算法所处的瞬时分配状态：
> The challenging part of the computation is the linear scan register allocation itself. We encode this using a predicate `reg_assignment`, which simulates the algorithm's state at every step across a linear scan of instructions:
```datalog // After instruction, this is the register assignment. Var = "none" is a possibility .decl reg_assignment(insn:Instruction, reg:Register, var:Var) ```
在处理每一条指令时，算法都会跟踪被分配的各个物理寄存器当前存放的内容。当前未存放任何变量的空闲寄存器，会被填入一个对应其寄存器编号的伪变量 (Pseudo-Variable)——例如，当 `0` 号寄存器为空时，它存放的是伪变量 `none_0`。这种编码技巧巧妙地将每一次分配决策都统一转化为了变量之间的优先级对比。在选择需要被溢出的变量时，比较器总是优先选择 `"none"` 伪变量（相当于直接占用空闲寄存器）而非真实变量；而在多个真实变量狭路相逢时，它则执行标准的线性扫描策略：将活跃区间结束时间最晚的那个变量溢出到栈中。
> At every instruction, the algorithm tracks the current contents of each physical register being allocated. Registers not currently holding a variable instead hold a pseudo-variable corresponding to the register's name—for instance, when register `0` is empty, it contains the variable `none_0`. This encoding lets us phrase every allocation decision as a comparison between variables. When choosing a variable to spill, the comparator always prefers a `"none"` variable over a real one; between real variables, it applies the standard linear scan policy of spilling whichever variable's liveness interval ends last.

item.title: 利用大模型将 Rockbox 固件移植到 9 美元 AliExpress MP3 播放器
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-22/利用大模型将-Rockbox-固件移植到-9-美元-AliExpress-MP3-播放器/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-22/利用大模型将-Rockbox-固件移植到-9-美元-AliExpress-MP3-播放器/
item.description:
作者借助 Claude / Opus 5.5 大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 智能体 (AI Agent) 与 Ghidra MCP 逆向工具，在完全不拆机、不焊接任何排线的纯软件环境下，奇迹般地将经典开源音频固件 Rockbox 移植到了一款售价仅 9 美元、毫无硬件文档的 AliExpress “YP3” MP3 播放器上。面对仅有 512 KiB SRAM 的极限内存瓶颈（远低于 Rockbox 以往 2 MiB 的官方最低运行门槛），AI 智能体通过网络摄像头、音频线路输入与定制的双向 USB 终端，通宵达旦地自主完成了逆向分析、固件烧录、驱动适配与压力测试，甚至实现了蓝牙音频传输及 357 款游戏插件移植。这项硬核工程不仅展现了 AI 在高难度嵌入式系统与底层驱动开发中的惊人自主潜能，更沉淀出了一套可复用的自动化固件移植工具箱。
---
## 概述
> ## Summary
借助大语言模型编程智能体（主要使用 Claude / Opus 5.5，并搭配 Ghidra MCP 逆向工具及净室逆向工程体系），作者成功将著名的开源播放器固件 [Rockbox](https://www.rockbox.org/) 移植到了一款硬件信息毫无公开文档、售价仅 9 美元的 AliExpress “YP3” MP3 播放器上。该播放器搭载了一颗神秘的国产芯片 Smartlink SL6801 片上系统 (SoC)，其内部仅有 512 KiB 的静态随机存取内存 (SRAM)——远低于 Rockbox 此前官方要求的 2 MiB 最低运行门槛。在完全无需电烙铁焊接、甚至连外壳都未曾拆开的纯软件操作下，AI 智能体配合网络摄像头、电脑音频输入口 (Line In)、蓝牙适配器以及扩展的双向 USB 开发者终端，完全自主地完成了固件烧录、驱动调试、XIP Flash 性能瓶颈分析以及通宵达旦的高强度破坏性测试。最终的移植固件不仅支持绝大多数主流音频编解码器、蓝牙音频与 HID 外设、纯磁盘音乐数据库和自定义主题，还具备约 20 小时的超长电池续航，并新增了多达 357 款游戏与插件；同时该项目还沉淀出了一套通用的自动化移植工具链 [auto-rockbox](https://github.com/jaydens-tasty-slop/auto-rockbox)，随后仅用 4 小时就成功将 Rockbox 移植到了另一款全新的播放器上。
> Using LLM coding agents (primarily Claude/Opus 5.5 alongside Ghidra MCP and a cleanroom reverse-engineering setup), the author ported [Rockbox](https://www.rockbox.org/) to an undocumented, $9 AliExpress "YP3" MP3 player powered by a mystery Smartlink SL6801 SoC with just 512 KiB of SRAM—well below Rockbox’s previous 2 MiB minimum target. Operating entirely via software without soldering or opening the case, the agent used a webcam, PC line-in audio, a Bluetooth dongle, and an extended bidirectional USB dev shell to autonomously flash firmware, debug drivers, profile XIP flash bottlenecks, and torture-test the device overnight. The resulting port supports most major audio codecs, Bluetooth audio and HID devices, an on-disk database, custom themes, ~20-hour battery life, and 357 newly added games and plugins, while producing a reusable [auto-rockbox](https://github.com/jaydens-tasty-slop/auto-rockbox) toolkit that subsequently ported Rockbox to another player in just four hours.
---
对于各种经典 MP3 播放器和 iPod 而言，[Rockbox](https://www.rockbox.org/) 是一个充满极客情怀且历史悠久的第三方开源固件项目。当年给我的 [Sansa E200](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sansa_e200_series) 刷入 Rockbox 的经历，堪称我人生中的一次顿悟时刻：计算机无处不在，如果它们不能做一些很酷的事情，那只是因为还没有人花心思去为它们编写对应的程序而已。回想起来，这对我后来的职业生涯抉择起到了不可忽视的作用。
> [Rockbox](https://www.rockbox.org/) is a wonderful old custom firmware project for a variety of MP3 players and iPods. Flashing Rockbox to my [Sansa E200](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sansa_e200_series) was a seminal moment for me: computers were everywhere, and if they didn’t do cool things, it was because no one had bothered to program them to do so. Looking back, that played no small part in my choice of career.
然而到了 2026 年，市面上似乎已经找不到任何 Rockbox 官方支持的廉价 MP3 播放器了。逆向工程这样一套未知的嵌入式硬件平台，是我能想到的技术挑战中最艰难的事情之一。于是我决定咬咬牙，花大价钱订阅了带有高额补贴的 Token 套餐，打算把大模型的能力压榨到极限——而正好我手头就躺着这么一台在 AliExpress 上花 9 美元淘来的白菜价 MP3 播放器。
> It seems like in 2026 there aren’t any cheap MP3 players that Rockbox supports, though. Reverse engineering an embedded platform like this is one of the hardest things I can think of, so I decided to pay the big bucks for one of those subsidized token plans to push it as hard as I could—and I happened to have a dirt-cheap $9 AliExpress MP3 player lying around.
**太长不看 (TL;DR)**：AI 成功把 Rockbox 移植到了一台只有 512 KiB 内存的设备上，而我几乎全程都在甩手当掌柜。随后我让它基于第一次尝试中行之有效的经验，构建了一套可复用的工具包与移植技能库，接着 Claude 仅用了 4 个小时，就让 Rockbox 在另一款全新的 MP3 播放器 (TS47) 上顺利跑了起来。
> **TL;DR:** It ported Rockbox to a 512 KiB player, and I was barely involved. Then I had it build a reusable toolkit and set of skills for future ports based on what worked from the first attempt, and Claude was able to get Rockbox running on another MP3 player (TS47) in 4 hours.
- **演示视频**：[在 YouTube 上观看](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/4_XmC1UqO1U?si=zrLtwsddV3i1syp6) - **项目主页**：[https://rockslop.jayd.ml](https://rockslop.jayd.ml) - **移植工具箱**：[GitHub 上的 auto-rockbox](https://github.com/jaydens-tasty-slop/auto-rockbox)
> - **Demo Video:** [Watch on YouTube](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/4_XmC1UqO1U?si=zrLtwsddV3i1syp6) > - **Project Website:** [https://rockslop.jayd.ml](https://rockslop.jayd.ml) > - **Porting Toolkit:** [auto-rockbox on GitHub](https://github.com/jaydens-tasty-slop/auto-rockbox)
---
## 登场：神秘的 YP3 播放器
> ## Enter: The YP3
![listing from aliexpress](./images/274098369b87.png)
这是一款典型的白牌播放器，在 Amazon 和 AliExpress 上以各种如同乱码辅音拼凑出的山寨品牌名进行销售。如果你从 Alibaba 上大批量批发，单个进货价甚至还不到 7 美元。
> This is an unbranded player sold under a variety of fake consonant-soup brands on Amazon as well as AliExpress. You can order them wholesale from Alibaba for less than $7 each.
在系统内置的“关于”菜单里，它将自己标识为 `yp3_2.0.43`。[这里似乎是 YP3 的一个购买链接](https://www.aliexpress.us/item/3256807764385286.html)（我当初买的原始商品页面已经下架了；我买的时候包邮花了 9.71 美元）。
> It identifies itself as `yp3_2.0.43` in the "About" menu. [This appears to be a listing for a YP3](https://www.aliexpress.us/item/3256807764385286.html) (the original listing is gone; I paid $9.71 shipped for mine).
> 💬 [原文提示 / Original Note]: > **注意**：在大家急着跑去下单之前提醒一下，我还有另一款设备的 Rockbox 移植工作大概再过一两周就能完工——目前已经能够稳定开机，只需进行更多验收测试。那台设备非常相似，但配备了 4 MiB 的伪静态随机存取内存 (PSRAM)，因此做出的功能妥协要少得多。[打折促销时只需 20 美元](https://www.tengsen.vip/pages/mp3-player-w1.html)。 > > 我手头还堆了一大堆各种随手买来的杂牌 MP3 播放器，打算后续挨个复现这个移植流程。详情可以查看项目主页：[https://rockslop.jayd.ml](https://rockslop.jayd.ml)。
> 💬 [原文引用 / Original Quote]: > > **Note:** Before you run off and buy one, I have another Rockbox port that is probably a week or two out—it is booting and stable, and just needs more acceptance testing. That device is extremely similar but has 4 MiB PSRAM, so it has fewer compromises. [It was $20 on sale](https://www.tengsen.vip/pages/mp3-player-w1.html). > > > > I also have a stack of other random MP3 players I intend to repeat this with. See the project website: [https://rockslop.jayd.ml](https://rockslop.jayd.ml).

item.title: 在编程语言中实现全自动形式化证明
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-17/在编程语言中实现全自动形式化证明/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-17/在编程语言中实现全自动形式化证明/
item.description:
长期以来，软件工程领域一直梦想能像证明数学定理一样，从数学上彻底证明代码绝对没有漏洞，但传统形式化验证繁琐的手工证明过程往往让工程师望而却步。本文探讨了一种将前沿证明自动化与现代编程语言深度融合的新范式：通过巧妙融合可变值语义 (Mutable Value Semantics, MVS)、契约式设计 (Design by Contract) 与细化类型 (Refinement Types)，并交由 SMT 求解器与交互式定理证明器 Lean 自动推理验证。该方案巧妙绕开了传统堆内存别名带来的复杂分离逻辑，在编译期便将整数溢出、缓冲区越界等经典漏洞一网打尽。尽管这带来了更高的编译期算力开销，却为安全至上的系统级软件开辟了一条从“事后修补漏洞”迈向“数学级别零缺陷”的全新演进之路。
---
## 核心概述
> ## Summary
近年来，全自动形式化证明技术的突破性进展为我们打开了一扇通往新世界的大门，也提出了一个关键问题：我们该如何利用自动化推理，从根本上大幅跃升软件的可靠质量与可读性？
> Recent breakthroughs in proof automation have opened the door to a critical question: how can we use automated reasoning to dramatically improve software quality and understandability?
与其从零开始发明轮子，我们不如站在数十年编程语言设计的深厚积淀之上，将历经验证的成熟理念——例如 **可变值语义 (Mutable Value Semantics, MVS)**、**契约式设计 (Design by Contract)** 和 **细化类型 (Refinement Types)**——与现代 SMT 求解器 (SMT Solver) 以及定理证明助手 (Proof Assistant，如 Lean) 强强联合。尽管这种方案在代码编译期会消耗不菲的算力，但它能从数学根源上直接消灭一整类臭名昭著的软件缺陷（例如整数溢出与缓冲区越界），巧妙绕开复杂繁琐的分离逻辑 (Separation Logic)，从而在无需繁复人工证明的前提下，确保高复杂度代码的行为分毫不差地契合其形式化规范 (Formal Specification)。
> Rather than starting from scratch, we can look at decades of programming language design and combine proven concepts—such as **Mutable Value Semantics**, **design by contract**, and **refinement types**—with modern SMT solvers and proof assistants (like Lean). While this approach demands significant computational power during compilation, it eliminates entire classes of bugs (like integer overflows and buffer overruns), simplifies verification by sidestepping separation logic, and ensures that complex code behaves exactly according to its formal specification.
---
## 现代可验证语言的核心要素
> ## Ingredients of a Modern Verifiable Language

item.title: 在 TPU 上实现位级零误差的同策略强化学习
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-17/在-TPU-上实现位级零误差的同策略强化学习/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-17/在-TPU-上实现位级零误差的同策略强化学习/
item.description:
大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 的强化学习训练对数值精度极其敏感，微小的计算误差即可导致训练严重失稳。然而在工业生产实践中，为了兼顾高吞吐与高算力，采样推理与梯度训练往往被切分在两条独立的计算流水线上；浮点运算在多轮长对话轨迹中累积的舍入偏差，悄然引入了隐秘的“异策略漂移”。为了攻克这一系统难题，Google Tunix 团队在 64 块 TPU v5p 集群拓扑上构建并验证了 Zero-TIM 架构，通过对分片内算子内核的精确固化、跨卡规约通信的严格时序重组以及自动微分与推理算子的解耦复用，首次实现了推理与训练在位级别 (Bitwise) 完全零误差的一致性。这项突破彻底消除了困扰分布式大模型强化学习的数值漂移，为业界在大规模 TPU 集群上稳定训练前沿推理模型树立了全新的技术标杆。
---
## 内容提要
> ## Summary
大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 的强化学习 (Reinforcement Learning, RL) 训练对数值不稳定性极其敏感。在轨迹采样生成 (rollout generation) 与梯度更新之间，哪怕产生极其微小的数值出入，都可能导致训练失稳甚至收敛停滞。在工业界实际的生产级强化学习系统中，采样与训练通常分别运行在独立的专用执行路径上；浮点数舍入误差随着多轮交互轨迹层层累加，无意间引入了隐秘的异策略 (off-policy) 偏差。
> Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models is notoriously sensitive to numerical instabilities. Even tiny discrepancies between rollout generation and gradient updates can destabilize training or stall convergence. Production RL stacks typically run sampling and training through separate execution paths, inadvertently introducing a hidden off-policy gap that compounds over multi-turn trajectories due to floating-point rounding errors.
本文向大家介绍 **训练-推理位级零误差 (Zero Train–Inference Mismatch, Zero-TIM)**——该方案在开源库 [Tunix](https://github.com/google/tunix) 中构建，并在由 64 块 TPU v5p 芯片 (`DP8×TP8`) 组成的多主机集群规模下完成了验证。Zero-TIM 能够确保在模型权重完全相同的前提下，采样器与训练器针对完全一致的动作与 Token 历史，计算出在位级别 (Bitwise) 分毫不差的对数概率 (logprobs)，为 TPU 上的强化学习训练带来真正坚固的同策略稳定性。
> This post introduces **Zero Train–Inference Mismatch (Zero-TIM)**—developed in [Tunix](https://github.com/google/tunix) and verified at multi-host scale across 64 TPU v5p chips (`DP8×TP8`). Zero-TIM ensures that the sampler and trainer assign bitwise-identical logprobs to the same action and token history under identical weights, bringing true on-policy stability to TPU RL training.
---
![zero_tim_tpu_blog_header_1600x900](./images/b7cd9f1dbad1.png)
---
## 问题的根源：隐秘的异策略偏差
> ## The Problem
在基于大语言模型的强化学习中，模型本身充当策略函数 $\pi(\text{action} \mid \text{previous tokens})$，而纯粹的同策略学习要求每次参数更新中的每一个动作，都必须由该策略本身生成并以完全一致的逻辑进行评估。尽管同步训练循环能够确保用于打分的模型权重与生成采样数据时的权重完全一致，但背后还有一个至关重要的数值计算前提：采样器与训练器对该策略的数值计算结果必须完全一致。
> In LLM RL, the model serves as the policy $\pi(\text{action} \mid \text{previous tokens})$, and true on-policy learning requires every action in an update to be generated and evaluated by that exact same policy. While a synchronous loop ensures each rollout batch is scored using the same weights that generated it, a critical numerical requirement remains: the sampler and trainer must evaluate that policy identically.
在实际生产实践中，强化学习架构通常将采样推理与模型训练划分到两条不同且高度优化的执行路径中：
* **采样器 (Sampler)**：在自回归增量解码 (incremental decoding) 期间逐一选择每个动作 Token，并记录其行为对数概率； * **训练器 (Trainer)**：在批量前向和反向传播计算中评估相同的 Token，从而计算其当前对数概率以及梯度。
> In practice, production RL stacks run sampling and training through separate, specialized execution paths: > * **The sampler** chooses each action token during incremental decoding and records its behavior logprob. > * **The trainer** evaluates the same token in batched forward-backward passes to compute its current logprob and gradients.
即便在模型权重毫无二致的情况下，这两条截然不同的执行路径依然可能针对同一个上下文和相同的 Token，计算出存在细微差异的对数概率。从算法调度逻辑来看，整个训练流程虽然名义上是同策略的，但在底层数值计算层面，却悄然潜入了隐秘的异策略偏差，并在多轮交互的长轨迹中如滚雪球般累积放大。
> Under the same weights, these differing execution paths can still assign different logprobs to the same token and context. The training schedule is on-policy, but the numerical execution has introduced a hidden off-policy gap that compounds over multi-turn trajectories.
---
## 偏差由何而来：浮点运算的非结合律
> ## Why It Happens
计算机中的规约 (reduction) 运算本质上是由浮点数加法构建的计算树。由于浮点加法并不满足数学上的结合律，计算树的结构一旦改变，舍入发生的位置也会随之改变。这种效应在精度低于 float32 的 **bfloat16** 格式下尤其容易暴露。
> A reduction is a tree of floating-point additions. Floating-point addition is not associative, so changing the tree changes where rounding occurs. The effect is easier to expose in **bfloat16**, which retains less precision than float32.
下面这个 bfloat16 示例清晰地展示了规约加法顺序带来的影响：
> The following bfloat16 example isolates the effect of reduction order:
![figure-1-reduction-trees](./images/4a452048f8a3.png) 图 1: 在数值 2.0 附近，每个 0.0078125 输入刚好是到达下一个可表示 bfloat16 数值距离的一半。“舍入到最近的偶数”规则在单独相加时会丢弃每个输入；而先将相同的小输入合并相加，则能顺利进位到下一个数值。
> **Figure 1.** Near 2.0, each 0.0078125 input is half the distance to the next representable bfloat16 value. Round-to-nearest-even discards each input when added separately; grouping the same inputs first reaches the next value.
同样的问题也会在深度学习模型的规约计算中频繁出现：矩阵乘法需要累加部分和 (partial sums)，归一化层需要计算统计量，张量并行 (tensor-parallel) 的不同分片需要汇总合并各自分片的部分输出。在我们早期的系统实现中，采样器的解码过程与训练器的前向传播采用了不同的 Token 数组形状以及不同的前向计算实现方式。JAX 会根据输入张量的形状专门特化编译计算图，而且训练时的前向传播是在自动微分程序内部运行的。
> The same issue appears in model reductions: matrix products accumulate partial sums, normalization computes statistics, and tensor-parallel shards combine partial outputs. In our original stack, sampler decode and trainer forward used different token-array shapes and forward implementations. JAX specializes computations to their input shapes, and the training forward also runs inside a differentiated program.
在这些不同的执行路径之间，规约加法的顺序以及中间计算精度未能保持严格一致。微小的浮点舍入差异最终转化为对数概率在二进制位层面的不同。模型权重和数学公式虽然完全一样，但底层的实际算术计算过程却各不相同。
> Across these paths, reduction order and intermediate precision were not consistently aligned. Floating-point rounding turned those arithmetic differences into different logprob bits. The weights and model equations were identical; the arithmetic was not.
---
## 对齐约定：三方一致性校验契约
> ## The Alignment Contract
这项对齐约定十分明确：在采样解码 (sampler decode)、推理预填充 (serving prefill) 以及训练前向传播 (trainer forward) 这三条路径之间，对于每一个被采样的动作，都必须产生位级完全一致的对数概率——在相同的采样权重、Token 历史和采样配置下，直接对比底层原始的浮点字节，允许的舍入误差或公差为绝对的零。
> The contract is simple: across sampler decode, serving prefill, and trainer forward, all three paths must produce bitwise-identical logprobs for every sampled action—comparing raw floating-point bytes under the same rollout weights, token history, and sampling settings, with zero rounding or tolerance.
为什么是三条路径而不是两条？在一个解耦的强化学习系统栈中，如果直接发现采样器与训练器存在数值分歧，我们只能确认存在数值偏差，却无法定位偏差究竟是在哪个环节产生的。通过引入推理预填充作为中间检查点，数值对齐转变成了一套**任何强化学习架构均可采用的系统化两步诊断机制**：
> Why three paths instead of two? In a decoupled RL stack, a direct sampler–trainer disagreement shows that a numerical gap exists, but not where it enters. Introducing serving prefill as a middle checkpoint turns alignment into a **systematic two-step diagnostic that any RL stack can adopt**:
* **采样解码 vs. 推理预填充**：验证推理服务引擎在自回归增量 Token 生成与全序列重新打分之间，自身内部是否完全一致。 * **推理预填充 vs. 训练器**：验证推理服务引擎与训练引擎在跨越不同编译优化与自动微分边界时，是否保持完全一致。
> * **Sampler decode vs. prefill** verifies that the serving engine agrees with itself between incremental token generation and full-sequence re-scoring. > * **Prefill vs. trainer** verifies that the serving and training engines agree across compilation and differentiation boundaries.
![figure-2-policy-contract](./images/ec9f4e9ddd92.png) 图 2: 在完全相同的采样权重下，对推理引擎内部以及推理与训练边界之间的采样动作对数概率进行位级比对。
> **Figure 2.** Bitwise comparisons of sampled-action logprobs within the serving engine and across the serving–training boundary, evaluated at the same rollout weights.
---
## 我们如何在 TPU 上构建 Zero-TIM
> ## How We Built Zero-TIM on TPU
实现 Zero-TIM 并不需要把采样器和训练器强行合并为一个臃肿的单体引擎。相反，我们采用了一套**极具通用性的四步工程方案**，在跨多主机 TPU 网格拓扑上无缝衔接独立的推理与训练流水线：锁定分片内的算子内核累加过程、规范跨分片的规约顺序、标准化动作对数概率评分尾部，以及为推理内核封装自定义微分求导规则。
> Achieving Zero-TIM does not require merging the sampler and trainer into a single monolithic engine. Instead, we use a **generalizable four-part recipe** that bridges separate serving and training pipelines across multi-host TPU meshes: locking within-shard kernel accumulation, ordering cross-shard reductions, standardizing the logprob scoring tail, and wrapping serving kernels with custom differentiation rules.

item.title: Hegel-clj 发布：面向 Clojure 的下一代生成式测试库
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-16/Hegel-clj-发布-面向-Clojure-的下一代生成式测试库/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-16/Hegel-clj-发布-面向-Clojure-的下一代生成式测试库/
item.description:
在现代软件工程中，生成式测试 (Generative Testing) 能够自动产生海量随机输入，是挖掘系统隐蔽漏洞的利器。然而，Clojure 社区长期依赖的主力库 `test.check` 基于“缩减树 (Shrink Trees) ”机制，在面对由 `bind` 组合的复杂生成器时，缩减算法经常陷入僵局，留下充斥着无用零值的庞大失败样例，给排查问题带来极大困扰。Python 生态著名的 Hypothesis 库开创了“内部测试用例缩减 (Internal Test-Case Reduction) ”范式，通过在测试失败时让生成器重新生成更小、更相似的输入，彻底解决了该难题。著名分布式系统专家 aphyr 结合这一最新理念，将新一代跨平台测试引擎 Hegel 引入 Clojure 生态并发布了 Hegel-clj，为开发者带来了兼具确定性随机数、极致缩减与原生 `clojure.test` 协同的现代化生成式测试体验。
---
我刚刚发布了 [hegel-clj](https://github.com/aphyr/hegel-clj)，这是面向 [Hegel](https://hegel.dev) 生成式测试 (Generative Testing) 库的 Clojure 接口。你可以直接跳到 [官方文档](https://cljdoc.org/d/com.aphyr/hegel-clj/0.1.1/doc/readme) 阅读上手指南，不过我想聊聊为什么我们还需要一个新的测试库，这背后的技术思考或许会更有趣。
> I’ve just released [hegel-clj](https://github.com/aphyr/hegel-clj), a Clojure interface for the [Hegel](https://hegel.dev) generative testing library. You can jump right to [the docs](https://cljdoc.org/d/com.aphyr/hegel-clj/0.1.1/doc/readme), but I thought it might be interesting to explain why I want another testing library.
---
## 内容概要
> ## Summary
* **`test.check` 的固有缺陷**：像 `test.check` 这样复杂的生成式测试库依赖缩减树 (Shrink Trees) 。当使用通过 `bind` 组合的生成器时，测试用例的缩减过程经常会卡死，导致吐出庞大得有些滑稽的失败样例 (例如：一个仅仅因为缩减算法无法有效缩减绑定参数，而充斥着大量无用零值的超长向量) 。 * **Hypothesis 开创的全新思路**：[Hypothesis](https://hypothesis.works/) 开创了“内部测试用例缩减 (Internal Test-Case Reduction) ”技术。生成器先产生单一值，并在测试失败时重新运行生成器，寻找更小但相似的变体。这一机制正是 **Hegel** 的基石。 * **全新亮相的 Hegel-clj**：为 Hegel 打造的简洁、跨平台 Clojure 包装层，提供了极其稳健的用例缩减能力、可预测的生成器组合机制、强大的宏 (`let`、`composite`) ，以及与 `clojure.test` 的无缝集成。
> * **The Problem with `test.check`:** Complex generative testing libraries like `test.check` rely on shrink trees. When using generators combined via `bind`, shrinking can frequently get stuck, yielding comically oversized failure cases (e.g., a massive vector padded with zeroes simply because the shrinking algorithm couldn't efficiently reduce the bound parameters). > * **The Hypothesis Approach:** [Hypothesis](https://hypothesis.works/) pioneered *internal test-case-reduction*, where generators produce a single value and re-run to find smaller variations if a test fails. This is the foundation of **Hegel**. > * **Introducing Hegel-clj:** A clean, cross-platform Clojure wrapper for Hegel that provides robust shrinking, predictable composition, powerful macros (`let`, `composite`), and a smooth `clojure.test` integration.
---
## 为什么 `test.check` 会在缩减时陷入僵局
> ## Why `test.check` Gets Stuck
在 Clojure 开发中，我经常使用优秀的 [test.check](https://github.com/clojure/test.check) 库来进行生成式测试。然而，使用 `test.check` 的过程有时令人相当抓狂！尤其是那些复杂的生成器，在用例缩减 (Shrinking) 阶段很容易卡死，结果往往只能靠人工手动去一点点裁剪复杂的失败数据结构。
> I do a lot of generative testing in Clojure with the excellent [test.check](https://github.com/clojure/test.check). However, using `test.check` can be frustrating! In particular, complex generators can get stuck during shrinking, leaving me trying to prune down a complex data structure by hand.
导致这种窘境的罪魁祸首通常是 `bind`。如果你还不熟悉 `test.check`、Quickcheck 或该家族中的其他测试库，简单来说，`bind` 是这样一种生成器：它首先抽取一个随机值，接着以该值为基础构建一个**全新的**生成器，再由后者去抽取另一个值。
> The culprit is usually `bind`. If you’re not familiar with `test.check`, Quickcheck, or other libraries in this family, `bind` is a generator which draws some random value, then uses that to construct a *new* generator, which in turn is used to draw some other value.
```clojure (require '[clojure.test.check :as tc] '[clojure.test.check.generators :as tcg] '[clojure.test.check.properties :as tcp])
(tcg/bind ; Take a number from `nat`, a generator of small positive ; integers. tcg/nat ; Now with that number, construct a generator of vectors, each ; with that many elements. (fn [size] (tcg/vector tcg/large-integer size))) ```
我们也可以用 `test.check` 的 `let` 宏来编写相同的逻辑，它在底层会被展开为一系列相互嵌套的 `bind` 调用。
> We can also write this using `test.check`’s `let` macro, which expands to a series of nested `bind`s under the hood.
```clojure (tcg/let [size tcg/nat] (tcg/vector tcg/large-integer size)) ```

item.title: 构建全天候 AI 智能体：驱动持久自主运行的五大核心原语
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-15/构建全天候-AI-智能体-驱动持久自主运行的五大核心原语/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-15/构建全天候-AI-智能体-驱动持久自主运行的五大核心原语/
item.description:
传统 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 大多依赖人类的主动呼叫与即时输入，处于“不问不动”的被动响应状态。然而，随着大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 推理判断力的飞跃以及长程任务执行成本的大幅下降，能够跨越会话边界、无需人工值守即可自主推进任务的“全天候智能体 (Always-On Agent)”正在成为现实。本文深入揭示了全天候智能体的工程本质——它并非永不停歇地狂刷 Token，而是在绝大部分时间保持“休眠”，并在事件触发时精准“唤醒”执行瞬时任务。围绕这一核心机制，文章解构了驱动持久自主运行的五大系统级架构原语：事件收件箱、定时器、持久化记忆、安全权限管理以及发件箱，为构建安全、经济且高可靠的自主智能体系统提供了极具指导价值的设计蓝图。
---
## 内容摘要
> ## Summary
全天候 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 是一种具备状态记忆与主动行动能力的人工智能系统。它们能够跨越不同的交互会话妥善管理上下文，并在无需人类实时监督的情况下自主执行任务。得益于前沿大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 综合判断能力的跃升以及长程任务运行成本的大幅降低，这类智能体彻底颠覆了传统的常驻进程模式——它们绝大部分时间都处于静默“休眠”状态，仅在特定触发条件下定期唤醒以完成短暂的运行批次。本篇架构解析将深入剖析构建全天候智能体所必需的五大核心原语 (Primitives)：事件收件箱、定时器、记忆机制、权限控制以及发件箱。
> Always-on agents are stateful, proactive AI systems that manage context across sessions and execute tasks autonomously without direct supervision. Driven by recent model advancements (such as improved judgment and lower operational costs for long-horizon tasks), these agents spend most of their time "asleep" and wake up periodically to complete brief runs. This architectural breakdown explores the five core primitives required to build always-on agents: an event inbox, timers, memory, permissions, and an outbox.
---
## 全天候智能体的生命周期循环机制
> ## The Cycle Behind the Always-On Agent
所谓“全天候智能体”，在底层架构上其实并非真正一刻不停地处于“开机运行”状态——“全天候”仅仅是对用户感知体验的一种形象描述。
> An always-on agent is not actually "always on"—this is simply a description of the user experience.
在真实的系统运行中，智能体绝大多数时间都处于休眠状态，只有当外界事件发生时才会按需唤醒去执行工作。我们将智能体单次连续的工作过程称为一次**运行周期 (Run)**：智能体接收到一个事件，完成对应的任务，并将运行过程中发生的重要信息持久化保存下来。而一个运行周期则依托于**会话 (Session)** 展开，会话完整记录了本次运行中所有的消息与工具调用日志。一旦当前运行周期的任务完成，智能体便会立刻重新归入休眠，如此周而复始、无限循环。
> In reality, the agent spends most of its time asleep, waking up periodically to do work. Each stretch of work is called a **run**: the agent receives an event, completes its task, and then saves information about what happened. A run works inside a **session**, which is the transcript of messages and tool calls. Once the run is finished, the agent goes back to sleep, and the cycle repeats indefinitely.
![全天候智能体时间线动图：大部分时间处于零 Token 消耗的休眠状态，被短暂的运行周期打断。每次运行包含四个步骤：事件到达、会话启动、智能体循环执行，以及运行结果写回跨周期传递的状态存储中。](./images/441cec25bae0.gif)
---
## 支撑全天候智能体的五大核心原语
> ## The Core Primitives
全天候智能体的外围系统架构牢牢扎根于五大核心原语之上：事件收件箱 (Event Inbox)、定时器 (Timers)、记忆机制 (Memory)、权限控制 (Permissions) 以及发件箱 (Outbox)。
> The surrounding architecture of an always-on agent relies on five core primitives: an event inbox, timers, memory, permissions, and an outbox.

item.title: 结合 Gemini 与约束求解器捕捉模糊测试错漏的 Go 代码缺陷
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-14/结合-Gemini-与约束求解器捕捉模糊测试错漏的-Go-代码缺陷/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-14/结合-Gemini-与约束求解器捕捉模糊测试错漏的-Go-代码缺陷/
item.description:
在 Go 语言日常开发中，传统的单元测试和基于随机输入的模糊测试 (Fuzzing) 常常由于切片底层容量 (Capacity) 等隐蔽盲区，漏掉极其致命的越界切片与行号边界逻辑缺陷。为了根治这一痛点，Google 团队构想出了一种前沿的软件工程验证新范式：先将 Go 源码跨平台编译为 RISC-V 汇编指令，精确定位那些经编译器静态单赋值 (Static Single Assignment, SSA) 优化后依然残留的 `runtime.panicBounds` 潜在崩溃陷阱；随后利用 Gemini 4 Argon 大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 深度理解代码控制流并秒级生成 Z3 约束求解器 (Constraint Solver) 规则；最后由求解器在毫秒内反向合成精准的崩溃复现输入，并在真实代码中直接验证。这一“大语言模型 + 形式化约束求解”的轻量化协同方案，不仅以极低的时间成本捕获了实际项目中的隐蔽漏洞，也为现代软件工程中缺陷挖掘与代码验证提供了全新的落地标杆。
---
## 核心概述
> ## Summary
在开发用于检查与编辑 Markdown 技能文件的 Go 命令行工具 `skill-lint` 时，传统的单元测试与模糊测试 (Fuzzing) 偶尔会遗漏微妙的切片边界与行号逻辑缺陷。为了彻底捕获这些隐藏的隐患，作者构建了一套创新的验证流水线：
> While developing `skill-lint`—a Go CLI used to check and edit Markdown skill files—traditional unit and fuzz testing occasionally missed subtle slice-bounds and line-number logic bugs. To catch these, the author built a novel verification pipeline:
1. **编译分析**：将目标 Go 函数编译为 RISC-V 汇编代码，以此找出经编译器静态单赋值 (Static Single Assignment, SSA) 优化器精简后仍然留存的 `runtime.panicBounds` 陷阱。 2. **AI 代码转换**：借助 **Gemini 4 Argon** 研读 Go 源码与汇编指令，将控制流执行路径直接转译为 **Z3 约束求解器 (Constraint Solver)** 的判定规则。 3. **自动化复现**：通过 Z3 自动求解并生成触发崩溃的具体字节输入，随后立即调用 `go test` 在真实代码中重放并验证缺陷。
> 1. **Compilation Analysis:** Compiling target Go functions to RISC-V assembly to locate surviving `runtime.panicBounds` traps left behind by the compiler's SSA optimizer. > 2. **AI Translation:** Using **Gemini 4 Argon** to read the Go source code and assembly, translating control-flow paths directly into **Z3 constraint solver** rules. > 3. **Automated Reproducers:** Using Z3 to generate concrete crashing byte inputs, which are immediately replayed and verified against the real code using `go test`.
本文将深入剖析这种混合验证方案的工作机理，揭示为什么标准模糊测试工具会因为切片容量盲区而漏掉潜在缺陷，探讨该方案的独到优势，以及它如何优雅地融入 Go 开发者的日常工作流。
> This post explores how this hybrid approach successfully uncovered latent bugs that standard fuzzers missed (due to slice capacity blind spots), where it shines, and how it fits into a day-to-day Go development workflow.
---
![title-image](./images/0d629712e1bc.png)
我参与领导 Google 的 [智能体技能项目 (Agent Skills Program)](https://github.com/google/skills)，该项目目前拥有 175 项智能体技能，对像 [go-skills](https://github.com/spf13/go-skills) 这样的社区资源形成了有力补充。为了保证这众多技能文件格式的高度统一，我编写了 `skill-lint`——一款独立的 [Go](https://go.dev/?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026) 命令行工具，专门用于在正式发布前检查 `SKILL.md` 文件并应用大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 生成的行级编辑。尽管 `skill-lint` 自身配备了完备的单元测试和模糊测试套件，但在其 Markdown 解析器或编辑应用器中，一处微小的切片截取或行号计算差错依然可能长期潜伏，直到遇到极其罕见的特殊文件或编辑区间时，才会在运行时触发 linter 崩溃 (Panic)。
> I help lead Google's [agent skills program](https://github.com/google/skills), currently with 175 agent skills that supplement community collections like [go-skills](https://github.com/spf13/go-skills). To keep that many skill files consistent, I wrote skill-lint, a standalone [Go](https://go.dev/?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026) CLI that checks SKILL.md files and applies LLM-generated line edits before they ship. Even with skill-lint's own unit and fuzz test suite, a small slice or line-number mistake inside its Markdown parsers or edit applier can sit dormant until an unusual file or edit range triggers a runtime panic in the linter.
在 Go 语言中，当编译器的优化器剥离掉所有能预先排除的安全检查后，每一个可能在运行时引发 panic 的切片或索引访问操作，都会在底层机器码中编译为一段显式的边界检查陷阱 (Bounds-check Trap)。为了搜寻潜在崩溃，我将代码中的关键函数进行编译，观察优化后幸存下来的 panic 陷阱，并利用 [Gemini 4 Argon](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-4-argon?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026) 将通往每个陷阱的执行路径翻译为 [Z3 约束求解器](https://github.com/Z3Prover/z3) 的规则。虽然大模型编写的求解器模型并非严格完备的证明系统，但它为智能体提供了一种推导控制流并合成具体 Go 复现测试用例的独立能力；而且由于 `go test` 会直接执行这些触发异常的字节，因此它捕获的每一个崩溃都是 100% 真实存在的。该工作流不仅捕获了我在测试解析器中故意埋下的全部 3 个漏洞，还在 `skill-lint` 中挖掘出了 3 个此前未被察觉的隐蔽缺陷。
> In Go, every slice or index operation that can panic at runtime compiles down to an explicit bounds-check trap in machine code, after the compiler's optimizer strips out the checks it can already rule out. To hunt for crashes, I compiled key functions from my code to see which panic traps survived optimization, and [Gemini 4 Argon](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-4-argon?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026) translated the path to each trap into rules for the [Z3 constraint solver](https://github.com/Z3Prover/z3). An LLM-written solver model isn't a sound proof system, but it gives the agent an independent way to reason about control flow and synthesize concrete Go reproducers, and every crash it finds is real because go test runs the offending bytes directly. That workflow caught all three bugs I planted in test parsers and turned up three latent bugs in skill-lint.
在本文中，我将逐步拆解 Gemini 与 Z3 验证流水线的实现原理，探讨为何 [`go test -fuzz`](https://go.dev/security/fuzz/?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026) 会漏掉其中的两个崩溃（以及只需一行改动就能修复该漏检的方法），并阐述这种方法在日常 Go 开发流程中的绝佳定位。
> In this post, I'll walk through how the Gemini and Z3 pipeline works, why [`go test -fuzz`](https://go.dev/security/fuzz/?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026) missed two of those crashes (and the one-line change that fixes it), and where this approach fits in a day-to-day Go workflow.
---
## 求解器流水线的工作原理
> ## How the solver pipeline works
Anthropic [近期的一篇博文](https://www.anthropic.com/research/formal-verification) 展示了如何通过前沿 AI 模型在 [OSS-Fuzz](https://github.com/google/oss-fuzz) 代码库上编写经机器检验的 [Rocq](https://rocq-prover.org/) 形式化证明，来捕获 C 和 C++ 中的潜在缺陷。形式化工具与依靠随机采样输入的模糊测试器不同，它是从每一个错误故障条件出发进行反向推导，精准求解出能触发该故障的确切输入。然而，完备的定理证明对于绝大多数日常 Go 项目而言过于沉重且门槛极高，因此我想探索的是：在一个函数耗时仅需约 1 分钟的前提下，智能体结合大语言模型与约束求解器究竟能发挥出多大的缺陷搜寻威力。
> A [recent post from Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/research/formal-verification) showed how formal verification catches latent bugs in C and C++ by having frontier AI models write machine-checked [Rocq](https://rocq-prover.org/) proofs across [OSS-Fuzz](https://github.com/google/oss-fuzz) libraries. Instead of sampling random inputs like a fuzzer, a formal tool works backward from each failure condition to solve for the exact input that triggers it. Full theorem proving is still too heavy for most day-to-day Go projects, so I wanted to see how much of that bug-hunting power an agent can get from an LLM and a constraint solver in about a minute per function.
在 C 和 C++ 语言中，读写超出缓冲区末尾会导致内存损坏。而 Go 语言则选择在运行时捕获越界访问：对于任何无法证明绝对安全的切片或索引访问操作，编译器都会将其编译为跳转至 [runtime.panicBounds](https://github.com/golang/go/blob/go1.27.3/src/runtime/panic.go#L208) 的显式条件分支。一旦执行到这里就会引发 panic，若未经 recover 捕获，整个进程便会直接崩溃退出。
> In C and C++, reading or writing past the end of a buffer corrupts memory. Go catches out-of-bounds access at runtime instead, compiling every slice or index operation it can't prove safe into an explicit branch to [runtime.panicBounds](https://github.com/golang/go/blob/go1.27.3/src/runtime/panic.go#L208) that panics, crashing the process unless recovered.
在生成机器码之前，Go 的 [静态单赋值 (Static Single Assignment, SSA)](https://pkg.go.dev/cmd/compile/internal/ssa?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026) [prove](https://github.com/golang/go/blob/go1.27.3/src/cmd/compile/internal/ssa/prove.go) 优化阶段已经通过追踪切片长度和循环变量，消除了其中的绝大多数边界检查。这道优化过滤工序最终仅留下了编译器自身无法彻底排除的 `runtime.panicBounds` 陷阱，正好为约束求解器提供了一份精炼的目标候选崩溃点清单。
> Before generating machine code, Go's [SSA](https://pkg.go.dev/cmd/compile/internal/ssa?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026) [prove](https://github.com/golang/go/blob/go1.27.3/src/cmd/compile/internal/ssa/prove.go) pass already eliminates most of those checks by tracking slice lengths and loop variables. That optimization pass leaves behind only the `runtime.panicBounds` traps the compiler couldn't rule out on its own, giving the solver a short list of candidate crash sites to target.
我使用 `GOOS=linux GOARCH=riscv64 go build -gcflags="-S -d=ssa/check_bce/debug=1"` 编译每个目标函数（其中 `-S` 用于打印汇编代码列表，`ssa/check_bce/debug=1` 则输出所有留存边界检查的详细日志），并将 Go 源代码与反汇编结果一同输入给模型。仅凭 Go 源码，你无法洞察编译器已经移除了哪些边界检查，也无法察觉寄存器是在哪一步被截断为 8 位的；但在反汇编代码中，这些底层细节一览无余。我之所以选择 [RISC-V](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RISC-V) 架构，是因为它正是 Anthropic 文章在 Rocq 形式化证明中选定的指令集架构，且 Go 原生开箱即用支持其交叉编译。
> I compiled each target with `GOOS=linux GOARCH=riscv64 go build -gcflags="-S -d=ssa/check_bce/debug=1"` (`-S` prints the assembly listing and `ssa/check_bce/debug=1` logs every surviving bounds check) and passed both the Go source and the disassembly to the model. Looking at Go source alone, you can't see which bounds checks the compiler already removed or where a register gets truncated to 8 bits; in the disassembly, both show up. I targeted [RISC-V](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RISC-V) because it's the instruction set Anthropic's post targets for its Rocq proofs, and Go cross-compiles to it out of the box.
随后，Argon 研读 Go 源码和反汇编代码，并返回一段用于为每个幸存陷阱建模执行路径的 Z3 脚本；每当它标记出缺陷时，还会同步给出一个修复后的补丁函数。Z3 紧接着检验这些约束条件是否可以满足 (Satisfiable)；一旦求得触发崩溃的输入，`go test` 就会针对真实函数重放这组字节。利用大语言模型让我免去了人工将汇编指令逐一转译为求解器约束的繁重劳动。在整个运行时间中，Argon 的转译占据了主要耗时（每个函数约 1 分钟），而 Z3 求解器本身的计算则在短短几毫秒内即可迅速完成。
> From there, Argon read the Go source and disassembly and returned a Z3 script modeling the path to each surviving trap, along with a patched function whenever it flagged a bug. Z3 then checked whether those constraints could be satisfied, and whenever it found a crashing input, `go test` replayed those bytes against the real function. Using an LLM saved me from translating assembly into solver constraints by hand. Argon's translation dominated the runtime, at about a minute per function, while Z3 itself finished in milliseconds.
![verification-harness](./images/4b4f069546ef.png) *图 1：Go 语言的 SSA 编译器会先剥离掉所有经证明安全的边界检查，随后由 Gemini 4 Argon 对留存的潜在陷阱进行建模，交由 Z3 完成求解检验。*
> *Go's SSA compiler strips out provably safe bounds checks first. Gemini 4 Argon then models the remaining traps for Z3 to check.*

## 何时应当信任约束求解器
> ## When to trust the solver
Anthropic 的方案依赖于 [交互式定理证明 (Interactive Theorem Proving)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Proof_assistant)，通常需要人类专家对机器语义进行形式化建模，再由 Rocq 根据这些严格规则检验大语言模型生成的证明过程。与之相对，我的工作流采用了基于 [可满足性模理论 (Satisfiability Modulo Theories, SMT)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satisfiability_modulo_theories) 的约束求解器，依托 Argon 将汇编逻辑直接翻译为 Z3 约束规则。虽然在缺乏严格语义模型的情况下，约束求解器无法给出百分之百完备的代码正确性证明，但它在挖掘缺陷方面却出奇地高效。Z3 的 [check-sat](https://microsoft.github.io/z3guide/docs/logic/basiccommands) 指令会在输入约束可满足时返回 `sat` (Satisfiable)，在不可满足时返回 `unsat` (Unsatisfiable)。
> Anthropic's approach relies on [interactive theorem proving](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Proof_assistant), where experts model machine semantics and Rocq checks LLM-generated proofs against those rules. In contrast, my workflow uses a constraint solver based on [satisfiability modulo theories (SMT)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satisfiability_modulo_theories), relying on Argon to translate assembly directly into Z3 constraints. While a constraint solver doesn't provide a complete correctness proof without a semantic model, it is highly effective for finding bugs. Z3's [check-sat](https://microsoft.github.io/z3guide/docs/logic/basiccommands) command returns sat when input constraints can be satisfied and `unsat` when they cannot.
当求解器返回 `sat` 结果（即“明确存在缺陷”）时，它会附带一组直指崩溃陷阱的具体字节数据，而 `go test` 会直接在真实函数上执行它们。一旦真实代码抛出 panic，无论 Argon 的求解器建模是否在理论上严丝合缝，你都已经获得了一个确定无疑的代码缺陷复现用例！正如面向缺陷的布隆过滤器 (Bloom Filter) 一样，`unsat` 结果仅代表代码“大概率正确”。牺牲严苛的绝对正确性证明，正是让该方案具备极高工程实用性的关键所在：仅需付出极其微小的精力和时间成本，你就能收获形式化方法最核心的缺陷挖掘价值。
> A sat answer ("definitely buggy") comes with concrete bytes aimed at the trap, and `go test` runs them against the real function. Once go test panics, you have a concrete bug reproducer regardless of whether Argon's model was sound. Like a Bloom filter for bugs, an `unsat` answer only means "maybe correct." Trading away a correctness proof is what makes the approach so practical: you get most of the bug-finding value of formal methods for a tiny fraction of the effort.
Anthropic 的方案在 64 MB 内存限制下证明了整个二进制程序的无崩溃特性；而我则针对单个函数，在全新的 64 字节切片且满足 [cap(buf) == len(buf)](https://go.dev/ref/spec?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026#Length_and_capacity) 的条件下进行检验，因此任何超出 `len(buf)` 的切片操作都会立刻引发 panic。（如果你想在 Go 中尝试全二进制的 Rocq 验证方案，[theorem-labs/oss-verify](https://github.com/theorem-labs/oss-verify) 包含了一套针对 [Go 1.27](https://go.dev/doc/go1.27?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026) 的运行时覆盖层，能使 Go 运行时变为单线程且完全确定性）。
> Anthropic's setup proved no-crash properties on whole binaries under a 64 MB budget; I checked individual functions on fresh 64-byte slices where [cap(buf) == len(buf)](https://go.dev/ref/spec?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026#Length_and_capacity), so any slice past `len(buf)` panics. (If you want the full-binary Rocq setup for Go, [theorem-labs/oss-verify](https://github.com/theorem-labs/oss-verify) includes a [Go 1.27](https://go.dev/doc/go1.27?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026) runtime overlay that makes the runtime single-threaded and deterministic.)
作为模糊测试的对比基线，我在 Go 1.27.3 环境下针对每个植入的缺陷运行了无种子的 [`go test -fuzz`](https://go.dev/security/fuzz/?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026)：包括一次 3 秒的快速运行以及三次 60 秒的运行；每次测试都清空缓存以避免测试时长过短成为漏检的借口。
> For the fuzzing baseline, I ran unseeded [`go test -fuzz`](https://go.dev/security/fuzz/?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026) on Go 1.27.3 against each planted bug: one 3-second run and three 60-second runs, each with a fresh fuzz cache so a short time budget wouldn't explain a miss.

## 在汇编代码中捕获植入的人工缺陷
> ## Finding a planted bug in assembly
在正式测试前，我首先选用了 3 个不存在越界漏洞的安全解析器，以确保流水线不会误报正常代码。编译器的 `prove` 优化阶段自主消除了 TOML 键名解析器中的所有边界检查；而对于 HTTP 报头扫描器和变长整数 (Varint) 解码器中残留的陷阱，Z3 均准确返回了 `unsat`（不可满足）。
> I started with three safe parsers to make sure the pipeline didn't flag clean code. The compiler's `prove` pass removed every bounds check in a TOML key parser on its own, and Z3 returned `unsat` on the remaining traps in an HTTP header scanner and a varint decoder.
随后，我编写了 3 个暗藏微小 panic 漏洞的解析器。这是其中的第一个——`ParseTwoChunkFrame`：
> Then I wrote three parsers with subtle panics. Here's the first one, `ParseTwoChunkFrame`:
```go func ParseTwoChunkFrame(buf []byte) ([]byte, []byte) { if len(buf) < 4 || buf[0] != 0xA5 || buf[1] != 0x5A { return nil, nil } hdrLen, bodyLen := buf[2], buf[3] total := hdrLen + bodyLen if int(total)+4 > len(buf) { return nil, nil } endHdr := 4 + int(hdrLen) endBody := endHdr + int(bodyLen) return buf[4:endHdr], buf[endHdr:endBody] } ```
在 RISC-V 反汇编代码中，这一缺陷变得清晰易见：
> In the RISC-V disassembly, the bug is much easier to see:
```plaintext 0x0060 ADD X16, X9, X5 ; X5 = hdrLen + bodyLen 0x0064 MOVBU X5, X5 ; TRUNCATE to uint8: X5 = X5 & 0xff 0x0068 ADDI $4, X5, X5 ; X5 = int(total) + 4 0x006a BLT X11, X5, 0x00bc ; guard: if len(buf) < X5, return nil, nil 0x006e MOV X9, X11 ; X11 = int(hdrLen) 0x0070 MOV X16, X14 ; X14 = int(bodyLen) 0x0072 ADD X14, X11, X9 ; X9 = int(hdrLen) + int(bodyLen) (unmasked!) 0x0076 ADDI $4, X11, X16 ; X16 = endHdr = 4 + int(hdrLen) 0x007a BLTU X12, X16, 0x00ec ; if cap(buf) < endHdr -> runtime.panicBounds ... 0x0090 ADDI $4, X9, X9 ; X9 = endBody = 4 + int(hdrLen) + int(bodyLen) 0x0092 BLTU X12, X9, 0x00e8 ; if cap(buf) < endBody -> runtime.panicBounds ```
代码中的 `total := hdrLen + bodyLen` 是将两个 `uint8` 类型的变量相加，因此在长度防护条件执行判定前，汇编中的 `MOVBU` 指令已经 [在 256 处发生了整数回绕溢出 (Integer Overflow Wrap)](https://go.dev/ref/spec?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026#Integer_overflow)；而在计算 `endBody` 时，指令相加的却是完整的 64 位整数。Argon 将这些汇编指令转化为一条 Z3 求解查询：询问对于一个长度至多为 64 字节的新建切片，是否存在某种输入不仅能够通过长度防护判断，而且仍会在 `0x0092` 处触发 `endBody` 边界检查失败：
> `total := hdrLen + bodyLen` adds two `uint8` values, so `MOVBU` [wraps the sum at 256](https://go.dev/ref/spec?utm_team=DSS+DevRel&utm_campaign=default&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=article&utm_content=b583878026#Integer_overflow) before the length guard checks it, while `endBody` adds the full 64-bit ints. Argon turned those instructions into a Z3 query asking whether a fresh slice of up to 64 bytes can pass the guard and still fail the `endBody` check at `0x0092`:
```python import z3
s = z3.Solver() length, capacity = z3.BitVecs("length capacity", 64) b0, b1, hdrLen8, bodyLen8 = z3.BitVecs("b0 b1 hdrLen8 bodyLen8", 8)
wrapped_sum64 = z3.ZeroExt(56, hdrLen8 + bodyLen8) + z3.BitVecVal(4, 64) end_hdr64 = z3.BitVecVal(4, 64) + z3.ZeroExt(56, hdrLen8) end_body64 = end_hdr64 + z3.ZeroExt(56, bodyLen8)
s.add(z3.UGE(length, 4), z3.ULE(length, 64), capacity == length) s.add(b0 == 0xA5, b1 == 0x5A) s.add(z3.UGE(length, wrapped_sum64), z3.ULE(end_hdr64, capacity)) s.add(z3.UGT(end_body64, capacity)) # panic at 0x0092 assert s.check() == z3.sat print(s.model()) ```
Z3 迅速给出了一个 59 字节的反例输入，其中 `hdrLen = 48` 且 `bodyLen = 236`：它们作为 `uint8` 相加后，其数值从 284 回绕溢出缩小至 28（因此 28 + 4 ≤ 59 顺利通过了长度防护），而随后执行的 `buf[endHdr:endBody]` 却要求截取到下标 288，从而直接引发了 panic 崩溃。
> Z3 returned a 59-byte counterexample with `hdrLen = 48` and `bodyLen = 236`: their `uint8` sum wraps from 284 down to 28 (so 28 + 4 ≤ 59 passes the guard), and `buf[endHdr:endBody]` then slices to index 288 and panics.
