item.title: Google DeepMind 利用 AI 智能体形式化验证 Signal 核心机器码
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-11/Google-DeepMind-利用-AI-智能体形式化验证-Signal-核心机器码/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-11/Google-DeepMind-利用-AI-智能体形式化验证-Signal-核心机器码/
item.description:
长久以来，形式化验证 (Formal Verification) 被誉为保障关键软件与加密通信绝对安全的“终极护城河”，但因其需要耗费人类专家海量心血手动编写数学证明代码，过去往往只能局限于高层理论或简化的抽象模型，难以直接验证真实部署的底层编译机器码。2026 年 11 月 10 日，Google DeepMind 团队正式推出了里程碑式的 AlphaProof Code 系统，利用由 Gemini 4 Carbon 与 Claude Opus 5.5 驱动的自主 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 战队，在短短 4 周内自动生成了约 650 万行经计算机严格检验的 Lean 形式化证明代码。这项技术突破首次在未做任何修改的前提下，对全球广泛使用的 Signal 核心加密通信库编译后的 AArch64 原生机器码完成了协议级安全性证明，并成功验证了捕获历史安全缺陷的能力。该成果开创了“人类专家把关安全规范边界、AI 智能体军团自动化推演证明”的高效协作范式，标志着高可信软件工程与形式化安全验证正式跨入全自动智能体时代。
---
## 核心内容摘要
> ## Summary
Google DeepMind 于 2026 年 11 月 10 日推出了 **AlphaProof Code**，通过调度多组自主 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 团队，为著名加密通信软件 Signal 编译后的 `libsignal` 底层代码生成了经计算机严格检验的 Lean 形式化安全证明。在一个为期四周的项目周期内，一支仅有 5 人的研究团队与由 Gemini 4 Carbon 和 Claude Opus 5.5 驱动的自主 AI 智能体紧密协作，总共生成了约 650 万行经机器检验的形式化证明代码。这项成就树立了一座关键里程碑——这是人类历史上首次对大规模部署的主流加密通信协议在未做任何修改的原生二进制机器码层面上，完成了协议级形式化安全证明。
> Google DeepMind introduced **AlphaProof Code** on November 10, 2026, utilizing teams of AI agents to produce machine-checked Lean proofs for security properties in Signal’s compiled `libsignal` code. Over a four-week period, a five-person research team—collaborating with autonomous AI agents powered by Gemini 4 Carbon and Claude Opus 5.5—generated approximately 6.5 million lines of machine-checked proof code. This marks a significant milestone as the first protocol-level security proofs applied to the unmodified binary code of a widely deployed cryptographic messaging protocol.
---
## AlphaProof Code 简介
> ## Introduction to AlphaProof Code
Google DeepMind 于 2026 年 11 月 10 日发布的 [AlphaProof Code](https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing-alphaproof-code/)，标志着自动化软件形式化验证领域迎来了重大飞跃。过去，安全研究人员往往只能依赖高度抽象的协议设计模型来进行验证；而这一次，研究团队直接对最终编译生成的真实软件实现本身进行了验证。
> Google DeepMind’s rollout of [AlphaProof Code](https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing-alphaproof-code/) on November 10, 2026, represents a major leap in automated software verification. Rather than relying solely on abstract models of protocol design, researchers verified the compiled implementation itself.
该团队将未做任何修改的 `libsignal v0.105.4` 与 `SPQR v1.6.0` 两个 Rust 代码包打包封装成一个小巧的命令行测试程序，并使用标准的 `rustc` 编译器构建出了一个静态链接的 AArch64 Linux 可执行二进制文件。根据其官方发布的[技术论文](https://google-deepmind.github.io/code-verification/)显示，这是人类首次在未对代码做任何简化或修改的前提下，对主流加密协议的真实实现完成了协议级形式化安全证明。
> The team wrapped unmodified versions of `libsignal v0.105.4` and `SPQR v1.6.0` crates into a small command-line harness, building a statically linked AArch64 Linux executable using standard `rustc`. According to the [technical paper](https://google-deepmind.github.io/code-verification/), this achievement yields the first protocol-level security proofs for unmodified code in a major cryptographic protocol implementation.
## AlphaProof Code 的人机协同分工模式
> ## How AlphaProof Code Divided the Work
在这项历时四周的研究项目中，人类研究员与 AI 智能体之间建立了一套高度专业化的分工与协作体系：
> The project relied on a specialized division of labor between human supervisors and AI agents over a four-week period:
* **人类专家的职责：** 研究员主要负责选定目标安全属性、厘清规则歧义、权衡安全性取舍、审查形式化安全规范，并掌握所有决策的最终审核与批准权。 * **AI 智能体的职责：** 在 [Gemini 4 Carbon](https://www.unite.ai/staged-rollout-sends-googles-gemini-4-carbon-to-cyber-defenders-first/) 和 Claude Opus 5.5 的强大算力与推理能力支持下，AI 智能体基于 2.6 万行受信任规范和 AArch64 指令集语义，起草、交叉审查并最终生成了大约 **650 万行经机器检验的 Lean 证明代码**。在此过程中，没有一位人类作者手动撰写过证明代码。 * **工作流协同机制：** 在典型的工作周期中，通常有 40 到 80 个自主智能体在工作站上以集群形式连续运行 24 到 72 小时。调度协调员 (Orchestrator) 与团队主管智能体负责统筹管理底层的证明生成工作者，而架构师与集成者智能体则负责维护整个证明库的一致性与严密性。
> * **Human Role:** Researchers selected target properties, resolved ambiguities, managed security trade-offs, reviewed specifications, and maintained final approval authority. > * **AI Agent Role:** Powered by [Gemini 4 Carbon](https://www.unite.ai/staged-rollout-sends-googles-gemini-4-carbon-to-cyber-defenders-first/) and Claude Opus 5.5, the agents drafted, cross-reviewed, and generated roughly **6.5 million lines of machine-checked Lean proof code** built upon 26,000 lines of trusted specifications and AArch64 semantics. None of the human authors wrote the proof code manually. > * **Workflow Dynamics:** Typical campaigns engaged 40 to 80 autonomous agents running continuously on workstations for 24 to 72 hours. Orchestrators and team leads managed proof workers, while architect and integrator roles maintained a unified proof base.
为了保证整个证明链条的绝对可靠，研究团队设计了一套严密的看门人机制 (Gatekeeping System)：只有当比较器确认生成的证明在每一个传递性定义上都与人类批准的规范丝毫不差时，Lean 证明器内核才会启动对证明的检验。任何对受信任假设的改动，都必须获得人类专家的显式签署批准，以彻底杜绝因安全规范被暗中放宽而导致的形式化证明失效风险。
> A strict gatekeeping system ensured safety: Lean’s kernel verified proofs only after a comparator confirmed they matched human-approved specifications down to every transitive definition. Any changes to trusted assumptions required explicit human sign-off to mitigate the risk of indirect specification weakening.
## 安全覆盖范围与历史已知漏洞验证
> ## Security Coverage and Historical Bug Tests
本次形式化验证的目标聚焦于一对一单聊会话的核心代码，覆盖了 **PQXDH 握手协议** 以及 **三重棘轮 (Triple Ratchet) 消息收发机制**。整套验证体系建立在两组相互独立的论证基础之上：
> The verification target focused on one-to-one session code encompassing the **PQXDH handshake** and **Triple Ratchet messaging**. The verification suite rests on two independent arguments:
1. **十项符号定理 (Symbolic Theorems)：** 在理想化的密码学数学假设下进行严格推导与求证。 2. **计算安全性证明 (Computational Proof)：** 借助统计学界限与密码学计算复杂度，定量限制攻击者所能获取的最大优势。
> 1. **Ten symbolic theorems** evaluated under idealized cryptographic assumptions. > 2. **A computational proof** bounding an attacker’s advantage through statistical and cryptographic terms.
本次项目形式化验证的核心安全属性包括：
> Core properties verified include:
* **前向保密 (Forward Secrecy)：** 即便通信当事方当前会话的状态密钥遭到窃取，历史过往的所有消息依然能够得到严密保护。 * **身份认证与握手保密性 (Authentication & Handshake Secrecy)** * **后妥协安全性 (Post-Compromise Security)：** 确保在系统经历局部安全泄露后，能够迅速自我修复并恢复端到端保密通信。
> * **Forward Secrecy:** Protecting historical messages if current state keys are stolen. > * **Authentication & Handshake Secrecy** > * **Post-Compromise Security:** Ensuring recovery following a security breach.

item.title: Google Cloud Pathways 运行时在 GKE 上正式商用：为超大规模 TPU 集群打造统一控制平面
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-11/Google-Cloud-Pathways-运行时在-GKE-上正式商用/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-11/Google-Cloud-Pathways-运行时在-GKE-上正式商用/
item.description:
在大模型与前沿多模态架构迈向万亿参数的时代，如何高效协同与调度成千上万颗 AI 芯片，是分布式机器学习领域面临的最核心瓶颈。Google Cloud 近日正式宣布，其划时代的分布式运行时 Cloud Pathways 在 Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) 上进入正式商用 (General Availability, GA) 阶段。这项底层技术最初由 Google DeepMind 研发，曾作为孵化 Gemini 等旗舰前沿模型的核心算力中枢，通过颠覆性的单一控制器架构，彻底摆脱了传统多控制器 JAX 方案中局部视角受限与协调脆弱的困境。无论是面对硬件故障时的秒级透明重分片与弹性自愈，还是支撑数万颗 TPU 芯片的高吞吐训练与强化学习推理，Pathways 在 GKE 上的落地商用，都为超大规模 AI 算力集群的基础设施管理树立了全新标杆。
---
## 概述
> ## Summary
Google Cloud 正式宣布 **Cloud Pathways** 在 Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) 上进入全面商用 (General Availability, GA) 阶段。该分布式机器学习 (ML) 运行时最初由 Google DeepMind 研发，专用于训练 Gemini 等前沿基座大模型，能为超大规模、异构的 TPU 计算集群提供先进的单一控制器 (Single-Controller) 架构。在正式发布前的短短 90 天内，各类用户通过 GKE 上的 Pathways 已经处理了超过 1.3 亿个 Cloud TPU 芯片时 (chip-hours) 的计算负载。该运行时不仅大幅简化了节点间的协同开销，显著提升了遇到硬件故障时的弹性恢复能力，还能够轻松扩展至数千颗 TPU 芯片上高效运转。
> Google Cloud has announced the General Availability (GA) of **Cloud Pathways** on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). Originally designed by Google DeepMind to train frontier models like Gemini, the distributed ML runtime offers a single-controller architecture for massive, heterogeneous TPU fleets. Within the first 90 days leading up to the announcement, users processed over 130 million Cloud TPU chip-hours using Pathways on GKE. The runtime simplifies coordination overhead, enhances elastic recovery, and scales efficiently across thousands of TPU chips.
---
## 跨 TPU 切片的统一控制器
> ## One Controller Across TPU Slices
在传统的默认多控制器 JAX 架构下，一旦计算规模扩大，系统就会变得异常复杂且脆弱，因为每一台 TPU 宿主机都必须运行独立的 Python 解释器，并且仅拥有自身所连设备的局部视角。
> Default multi-controller JAX setups can become complex and brittle at scale, requiring every TPU host to run a separate Python interpreter with only a local view of connected devices.
Cloud Pathways 彻底重构了这种模式，它基于开源的临时框架运行时 (Interim Framework Runtime) 构建了统一控制器。只需配合 `pathwaysutils` 将环境变量设置为 `JAX_PLATFORMS=proxy`，单个 JAX 客户端就能以全局视角编排跨越数千颗芯片的多个大型 TPU 切片 (TPU Slices)，操作体验犹如直接连接在本地设备上一样流畅。
> Cloud Pathways solves this by replacing that arrangement with a unified controller built on the open-source Interim Framework Runtime. By setting `JAX_PLATFORMS=proxy` alongside `pathwaysutils`, a single JAX client can view and orchestrate multiple large TPU slices spanning thousands of chips as if they were connected locally.
该统一控制器的核心能力包括：
> Key capabilities of the unified controller include:
* **计算图求值与编译缓存 (Graph Evaluation & Caching)**：统一管理计算图求值流程，并在 Cloud Storage 中实现持久化的编译缓存。 * **异步调度分发 (Asynchronous Dispatch)**：负责在不同 TPU 切片之间高效处理 XLA 计算任务的异步分发。 * **同机部署 Sidecar 容器 (Colocated Sidecars)**：支持共享内存的 Python Sidecar 容器可直接在 TPU 宿主机上运行分布式数据加载与模型检查点 (Checkpointing) 保存等高算力消耗任务。 * **弹性自愈训练 (Elastic Training)**：借助宿主机内存快照技术，当发生硬件中断故障时，能够无缝地将训练作业动态重新分片 (Reshard) 到少一个切片的剩余硬件上继续运行，而不会导致主客户端崩溃中断。 * **灵活的资源接入与共享 (Flexible Access)**：全面支持交互式 Notebook、终端命令行，以及 *共享 Pathways 服务 (Shared Pathways Service)*，允许多位用户按需共享同一个长期运行的 TPU 切片资源池。
> * **Graph Evaluation & Caching:** Manages graph evaluation and persistent compilation caching in Cloud Storage. > * **Asynchronous Dispatch:** Handles the asynchronous dispatch of XLA work across various slices. > * **Colocated Sidecars:** Python sidecar containers with shared-memory support run compute-intensive tasks—such as distributed data loading and checkpointing—directly on TPU hosts. > * **Elastic Training:** Uses host-memory snapshots to seamlessly reshard jobs onto one fewer slice after hardware interruptions without crashing the client. > * **Flexible Access:** Supports interactive notebooks, terminals, and a *Shared Pathways Service* that lets multiple users draw from a long-running pool of TPU slices.
---
## 生产落地与弹性故障自愈
> ## Production Use and Elastic Recovery
众多知名企业与前沿科研机构已经开始将 Cloud Pathways 应用于高强度的生产级工作负载中：
> Enterprise and research organizations are already leveraging Cloud Pathways for heavy workloads:
* **消费级科技巨头 (Consumer Technology)**：某大型消费科技企业在由数万颗 TPU v5p、Trillium v6e 和 Ironwood TPU7x 芯片构成的集群上，运行生产级批处理与强化学习推理任务，每季度消耗的计算量超过 1 亿芯片时。 * **ZenteiQ 机构**：在将该技术栈应用于科学基座模型的研发中，ZenteiQ 在 GKE 上结合 Cluster Toolkit 和宿主机快照技术，利用 Cloud Pathways 实现了基于 MaxText 的弹性预训练和强化学习。创始人 Sashikumaar Ganesan 指出，动态网格拓扑重映射 (Dynamic Re-meshing) 与秒级快速恢复能力大幅缩短了系统停机等待时间，使 TPU 算力能够始终保持满负荷运转。
> * **Consumer Technology:** A major consumer tech company runs production batch and reinforcement-learning inference on tens of thousands of TPU v5p, Trillium v6e, and Ironwood TPU7x chips, consuming over 100 million chip-hours per quarter. > * **ZenteiQ:** Applying the stack to scientific foundation models, ZenteiQ utilizes Cloud Pathways on GKE with Cluster Toolkit and host snapshotting for elastic MaxText pre-training and reinforcement learning. Founder Sashikumaar Ganesan noted that the dynamic re-meshing and rapid recovery significantly minimize downtime and keep TPU capacity fully utilized.
---
## GKE 正式可用与 Slurm 预览支持
> ## GKE Availability and Slurm Preview
* **GKE 正式商用 (GKE)**：Cloud Pathways 现已在所有支持 Cloud TPU v5e、TPU v5p、Trillium TPU v6e 及 Ironwood TPU 7x 的 Google Cloud 区域中正式面向 GKE 用户商用，并提供了适配 JAX 0.10.1 及更高版本的带版本容器镜像。 * **Slurm 预览支持 (Slurm Preview)**：通过与 Cluster Director 的独立集成，Cloud Pathways 的能力进一步延伸至 Slurm TPU 集群——将统一的多切片 JAX 执行、弹性自愈训练以及交互式 Notebook 全面带入预览 (Preview) 阶段。
> * **GKE:** Cloud Pathways is now generally available on GKE in all Google Cloud regions supporting Cloud TPU v5e, TPU v5p, Trillium TPU v6e, and Ironwood TPU 7x, with versioned container images supporting JAX 0.10.1 and later. > * **Slurm (Preview):** A separate integration with Cluster Director extends Cloud Pathways to Slurm TPU clusters—bringing unified multi-slice JAX execution, elastic training, and interactive notebooks into Preview status.

item.title: E2B 评测 NVIDIA Vera：高密度 AI 智能体沙盒集群的性能基准
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-11/E2B-评测-NVIDIA-Vera-高密度-AI-智能体沙盒集群的性能基准/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-11/E2B-评测-NVIDIA-Vera-高密度-AI-智能体沙盒集群的性能基准/
item.description:
随着大语言模型和 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 快速走向自主代码执行与复杂任务协作，如何在单台物理服务器上安全、高效、高密度地运行成千上万个轻量化隔离沙盒，成为当下 AI 基础设施面临的核心工程瓶颈。知名沙盒运行时平台 E2B 率先对 NVIDIA 即将推出的新一代 Vera 服务器展开了预生产环境下的深度基准测试 (Benchmark)。实测表明，在基于 Firecracker 微虚拟机 (MicroVM) 的高密度隔离架构下，双路 Vera 服务器能够稳定支撑多达 1,400 至 1,550 个并发活跃沙盒，并在单线程算力与快照恢复至关重要的内存吞吐量上显著超越传统 x86 参考架构。尽管实现极限密度依赖深入的宿主机内核与网络微调，且能耗经济性尚待多节点测试检验，该评测依然为下一代超大规模智能体集群的算力架构演进提供了极具价值的实证参考。
---
## 内容概要
> ## Summary
2026 年 11 月，E2B 公布了针对 [NVIDIA Vera 服务器](https://www.unite.ai/nvidia-pits-vera-cpu-against-x86-on-agent-speed-and-power-capacity/) 承载高密度 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 沙盒集群能力的早期工程测试结果。借助一台双路 Vera 预生产服务器，测试团队成功维持了 1,400 至 1,550 个高负载沙盒的稳定运行；在特定的处理器单线程与内存微基准测试 (Microbenchmark) 中，其性能更是显著超越了作为参照的 AMD EPYC 处理器。尽管这批早期实测数据展现出了微虚拟机 (MicroVM) 隔离扩展的巨大潜力，但该评估仍属于工程样机阶段测试，不仅依赖特定的宿主机参数深度调优，且在综合运营成本、整机能耗以及多节点扩展方面仍有待进一步验证。
> In November 2026, E2B published pre-production test results evaluating the performance of the [NVIDIA Vera server](https://www.unite.ai/nvidia-pits-vera-cpu-against-x86-on-agent-speed-and-power-capacity/) for high-density agent sandbox fleets. Utilizing a pre-production dual-socket Vera server, tests demonstrated the ability to sustain between 1,400 and 1,550 loaded sandboxes while outperforming an AMD EPYC reference in specific processor and memory microbenchmarks. While these early findings highlight significant potential for isolated microVM scaling, the evaluation remains a pre-production test with specific host tuning requirements and unresolved cost, power, and multi-node considerations.
---
## 处理器与内存微基准测试
> ## Processor and Memory Microbenchmarks
本次针对 Vera 的评测于 2026 年 10 月 9 日至 13 日展开，测试平台为一台配备 176 个物理核心和 1,479 GiB 内存的双路工程样机服务器，并将其性能与 2026 年 8 月测得的 AMD 平台基准数据进行了横向对比。
> The Vera tests were conducted between October 9 and 13, 2026, on a pre-production dual-socket server featuring 176 physical cores and 1,479 GiB of RAM, compared against AMD reference measurements taken in August 2026.
* **计算性能**：在基于宿主机裸机、采用 Vera 专属 64K 内存页内核的单线程计算测试中，E2B 测得 Vera 的吞吐量达到 **每秒 7,759 次事件**，而作为对照的 AMD EPYC 9B45 则为 **每秒 5,131 次**（基于至少 3 次测试的中位数计算，Vera 达到了参照系统吞吐量的 1.51 倍）。 * **内存吞吐量**：在针对 2 GiB 内存区域、采用 4K 内核并启用 2 MiB 大页内存 (Huge Pages) 的测试中（这也是 E2B 沙盒实际采用的大页内存支持机制），Vera 飙升至 **62.8 GB/s**，相比 AMD 的 **17.4 GB/s** 实现了高达 3.61 倍的吞吐量跃升。对于需要高频从快照恢复环境的沙盒运行时而言，这项指标至关重要。
> * **Compute Performance:** In a bare-host, single-thread compute test using Vera’s 64K-page kernel, E2B reported **7,759 events per second** for Vera compared to **5,131** for the AMD EPYC 9B45 (achieving 1.51 times the reference throughput based on the median of at least three runs). > * **Memory Throughput:** Testing a 2 GiB memory region using 4K kernels and 2 MiB huge pages (the same huge-page backing used by E2B's sandboxes), Vera reached **62.8 GB/s** compared to AMD's **17.4 GB/s**, marking 3.61 times the throughput. This metric is vital for a runtime that repeatedly restores snapshot-backed environments.
*注：上述对比严格受限于特定微基准测试下的指定硬件型号，并不代表端到端智能体执行速度获得了同等比例的提升，亦不构成相对于 AMD 的绝对集群容量优势。*
> *Note: These comparisons are limited to named systems in specific microbenchmarks and do not establish direct end-to-end agent speedups or absolute fleet-capacity advantages over AMD.*
## 全栈容量评估与宿主机调优
> ## Full-Stack Capacity and Host Tuning
在全栈容量评估中，E2B 采用了 **E2B Embed**——这是开源 E2B Runtime 及其监控面板的单机封装版本——直接运行在宿主机上，并通过 Firecracker 微虚拟机实现轻量化硬件级安全隔离。
> For full-stack evaluations, E2B utilized **E2B Embed**—its single-machine packaging of the open-source E2B Runtime and dashboard—running directly on the host with Firecracker microVM isolation.
* **系统响应能力**：在低负载的独立裸机测试中，评估记录到了 **50 毫秒的热启动顺序沙盒启动耗时** 以及 **3.8 毫秒的命令往返延迟**。在极高换流 (Churn) 压力测试下，系统连续完成了 **22,145 次沙盒创建与销毁循环，且保持零错误**。 * **混合负载表现**：在混合容量测试中，沙盒会交替执行 CPU 突发计算、10 MiB 磁盘写入与短暂休眠暂停（其中十分之一的沙盒保持持续运转），在此场景下第 95 百分位 (P95) 命令往返延迟最高仅为 **255 毫秒**。而当所有沙盒都处于持续不间断高压运行时，系统仍能稳定支撑 **550 个沙盒**。 * **配置约束与调优**：默认的宿主机操作系统配置仅能支持 320 个沙盒；在针对网络邻居表 (Network-neighbor) 进行内核调优后，容量提升至 1,000 个；而只有在完成全系统的底层调优后，才最终释放出巅峰并发容量。E2B 特别强调，这体现的是系统底层配置的阶梯式优化成果，而非单纯由 Vera 硬件架构直接带来的通用性加速。
> * **Responsiveness:** Evaluations recorded **50 ms warm, sequential sandbox starts** and **3.8 ms command round trips** at low load during separate bare-metal tests. A churn test completed **22,145 create-and-destroy cycles with zero errors**. > * **Mixed Workloads:** In mixed capacity tests where sandboxes continuously performed CPU bursts, 10 MiB disk writes, and pauses (with 1 in 10 running continuously), the 95th-percentile command round-trip latency peaked at **255 ms**. When all sandboxes ran continuously, the system sustained **550 sandboxes**. > * **Configuration Constraints:** Default host settings only supported 320 sandboxes. Network-neighbor tuning elevated this to 1,000, while full system tuning was required to reach peak capacity. E2B emphasizes this represents a configuration progression rather than a blanket Vera-versus-x86 speedup.
## 评估局限性与后续测试规划
> ## Evaluation Limits and Planned Tests
由于本次评估完全基于工程样机硬件展开，目前仍有一些关键技术问题尚待明确：
> Because the evaluation was conducted on pre-production hardware, several questions remain open:
* 作为对照的 x86 参考系统在某些特定的快照恢复操作上速度依然更快； * 嵌套虚拟化 (Nested Virtualization) 仍需要额外的底层工程开发与适配； * 本次测试未采集功耗与成本数据，因此尚未涵盖实际的单机运营经济效益评估。
> * x86 reference systems still completed certain restore operations faster. > * Nested virtualization requires additional engineering work. > * Operating economics were excluded, as no power or cost measurements were taken.
**后续计划**：E2B 计划进一步扩大测试范围，包括搭建多节点 [Vera](https://www.unite.ai/modal-plans-nvidia-vera-rollout-for-sandboxes-in-first-arm-move/) 集群测试、评估基于对象存储的冷快照恢复性能，并采用完全一致的软件封装与宿主机调优配置与 x86 平台进行标准化横向评测。
> **Next Steps:** E2B plans to expand its testing to include multi-node [Vera](https://www.unite.ai/modal-plans-nvidia-vera-rollout-for-sandboxes-in-first-arm-move/) clusters, cold resumes backed by object storage, and standardized x86 comparisons using identical packaging and host tuning.

item.title: 智能体记忆与做梦：通过离线整理让 AI 实现跨会话长期进化
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-10/智能体记忆与做梦-通过离线整理让-AI-实现跨会话长期进化/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-10/智能体记忆与做梦-通过离线整理让-AI-实现跨会话长期进化/
item.description:
在认知科学中，人类通常是在清醒时经历生活，并在睡眠或休息中通过海马体与大脑皮层的协作将瞬时体验固化为长期知识。Anthropic 的最新研究探索了 AI 智能体如何借鉴这一生物学机制，破解跨会话“用完即忘”的瓶颈难题。通过将原始对话记录、记忆笔记、网络化维基 (Wikis) 与一种被称为“做梦 (Dreaming)”的离线反思机制有机结合，AI 智能体能够在不同任务会话的间隔期自主纠正认知偏差、提炼核心经验并动态重塑记忆层级。这一机制不仅在复杂的持续学习基准测试中大幅超越了无状态基准模型，也为构建具备长期自主进化能力的下一代 AI 智能体奠定了关键基础。
---
## 摘要
> ## Summary
在认知科学中，生命始终在向前经历，但唯有通过记忆巩固 (Memory Consolidation) 才能向后理解——在人类睡眠或休息时，大脑会重放近期的体验，并将其深度整合至大脑皮层 (Neocortex) 中。如今，AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 也面临着极为相似的处境。本文将深入探讨现代大语言模型（特别是 Claude）如何在不同会话之间构建、提炼并高效运用长期记忆。通过将原始会话记录、记忆笔记、前沿维基 (Wikis) 知识库，以及一种被称为“**做梦 (Dreaming)**”的离线优化机制有机结合，AI 智能体能够真正从过去的交互中汲取经验、修正事实偏差，并敏锐预测未来任务所需的核心上下文。
> In cognitive science, life is lived forward but understood backward through memory consolidation—a process where the brain replays recent experiences during sleep or rest and integrates them into the neocortex. AI agents encounter a remarkably similar bind. This article explores how modern language models (specifically Claude) structure, refine, and utilize long-term memory across sessions. By combining session transcripts, memory notes, advanced wikis, and an offline optimization process known as **dreaming**, agents can learn from past interactions, correct factual drifts, and dynamically predict what future contexts will require.
---
## 1. 引言：人类与机器面临的共同困境
> ## 1. Introduction: The Human and Machine Bind
> 💬 [名言引用 / Quote]: > “生活只有在向后回顾时才能被理解，但生活必须向前经历。” —— Søren Kierkegaard
> 💬 [原文引用 / Original Quote]: > *"Life can only be understood backward, but it must be lived forward."* — Søren Kierkegaard
人类在日常活动中会持续通过海马体 (Hippocampus) 编码瞬时记忆。然而，只有极少数经过筛选的关键经历才会被进一步固化为大脑皮层中的长期知识，而这一沉淀过程往往在我们入睡或休息的离线状态下悄然完成。AI 智能体的记忆系统同样可以借鉴这种分工哲学：利用两次任务交互之间的闲暇时间重新梳理并重组上下文信息——这一机制被形象地称为“**做梦 (Dreaming)**”。借助做梦，AI 智能体得以从容复盘历史日志、修正此前犯下的错误，并沉淀出高度稳健的知识表征。
> As humans, we constantly encode memories via the hippocampus. Only select experiences, however, are consolidated into long-term knowledge in the neocortex, often occurring offline while we sleep or rest. Agent memory can use a similar division of labor. By leveraging idle time between interactions to reorganize context—a process called **dreaming**—AI agents can reflect on logs, fix mistakes, and produce robust knowledge representations.
![Diagram of a memory hierarchy between one session and the next. From bottom to top: transcripts, memory notes, memory representations, and injected context.](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2Fa0bcfa203214d817d2b4261b7188aba8be6db5b2-3840x1754.png&w=3840&q=75)
---
## 2. 记忆笔记
> ## 2. Memory Notes
所谓“智能体记忆”，特指 AI 智能体从实践经验中沉淀而来、并能在不同会话之间以可读上下文形式长期保留的知识系统。这里需要特别区分的是：它既不属于大模型底层的固定权重，也不等同于单次会话中的即时上下文学习 (In-Context Learning, ICL)，更不同于简单的对话上下文压缩摘要。
> "Agent memory" refers to knowledge gained from experience—retained between sessions as readable context—excluding model weights, single-conversation in-context learning, or compaction summaries.
正如同人类大脑利用神经化学信号对重要记忆打上标记、以便在后续离线状态下重放和稳固一样，Claude 也能够主动标记出关键的显著事件，或将探索过程中的洞察直接记录到持久化的记忆存储库中（例如专门存放记忆笔记的文件夹）。
> Just as chemical signals mark human memories for offline replay and stabilization, Claude can tag salient events or write observations directly into a persistent memory store (such as a folder of memory notes).
![The same memory hierarchy, with the memory notes layer highlighted.](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2F2ef2bf5c81ea6d578749782782eff10cf3136de4-3840x1754.png&w=3840&q=75)

item.title: 什么是 Pathways？Google 大模型单控制器分布式训练系统深度解析
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-10/什么是-Pathways-Google-大模型单控制器分布式训练系统深度解析/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-10/什么是-Pathways-Google-大模型单控制器分布式训练系统深度解析/
item.description:
面对当今动辄数千亿参数的前沿大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) ，传统的分布式训练架构正面临严峻的协同与通信瓶颈。Google 近日在 Google Cloud Platform (GCP) 上正式全面开放 (General Availability) 了其核心分布式训练引擎 —— Pathways，这项底层黑科技此前曾深度支撑了 Gemini 等顶级大模型的全流程训练。与业界主流的单程序多数据 (Single Program, Multiple Data, SPMD) 范式不同，Pathways 创新性地采用“单客户端 + 分布式运行时”的单控制器图计算架构，将模型构建逻辑与底层物理硬件彻底解耦。它不仅化解了跨节点同步带来的流水线空泡与数据中心网络阻塞，更实现了硬件单点故障时的秒级透明重映射与弹性容错，为超大规模异构 AI 训练树立了全新标杆。
---
## 概述与核心亮点
> ## Summary
Google 正式宣布在 Google Cloud Platform (GCP) 上全面商用 (General Availability) **Pathways** 服务。作为由 Google 专门打造的分布式计算系统，Pathways 是孕育出 Gemini 等超大规模旗舰模型的幕后功臣。本文将深入剖析 Pathways 是如何突破传统训练协同障碍的：它通过单一客户端将整个训练计算描述为一张计算图，并由底层的分布式运行时环境全权接管张量放置、通信路由、硬件设备利用率优化以及集群弹性容错等复杂任务。
> Google has announced the General Availability of **Pathways on Google Cloud Platform**. Pathways is the distributed system engineered by Google to train massive models like Gemini. This article explores how Pathways overcomes traditional coordination hurdles by using a single client to describe computations as a graph, while a distributed runtime handles tensor placement, routing, device utilization, and cluster resilience.
---
## 核心速览 (TL;DR)
> ## TL;DR
* **协同瓶颈的挑战**：传统的超大模型训练高度依赖单程序多数据 (Single Program, Multiple Data, SPMD) 架构 (例如 DDP 与 FSDP) 。在这种架构下，每个加速芯片都以“齐步走”的步调执行完全相同的代码。尽管 SPMD 在处理同构、规则的任务时行之有效，但在面对流水线并行或强化学习 (Reinforcement Learning, RL) 闭环等复杂拓扑时却捉襟见肘 —— 因为这些复杂场景往往需要不同程序同时并发运行并交叠执行。 * **硬件故障的沉重代价**：在 SPMD 模式下，集群中哪怕只有单台设备或单颗芯片发生硬件故障 (在 Gemini 2.5 训练期间，硬件故障甚至平均每小时就会发生数次) ，都会导致所有计算进程全面停摆，迫使整个训练任务回滚到上一个检查点 (Checkpoint) 重启。 * **Pathways 带来的破局解法**：Pathways 引入了单客户端架构，将整体计算建模为由计算块和张量组成的完整计算图。底层的分布式运行时能够将工作负载灵活分发到虚拟设备上，自主管理张量传输、实现弹性伸缩，并确保各类加速器始终维持在峰值吞吐量 (Throughput) 运转。
> * **The Coordination Challenge:** Traditional large-model training relies on Single Program, Multiple Data (SPMD) architectures (like DDP and FSDP), where every accelerator runs identical code in lockstep. While effective for uniform tasks, SPMD struggles with complex topologies like pipeline parallelism or reinforcement learning (RL) loops where different programs must run simultaneously and overlap. > * **The Cost of Failures:** In SPMD models, a single hardware failure (which interrupted Gemini 2.5 training multiple times per hour) stops every process, requiring a rollback to the last checkpoint. > * **The Pathways Solution:** Pathways introduces a single client that models computations as a graph of blocks and tensors. A distributed runtime places workloads onto virtual devices, handles tensor transfers, scales elastically, and keeps accelerators operating at peak throughput.
---
## 当扩展规模遇上协同瓶颈
> ## When Scaling Becomes a Coordination Problem
如果你经常使用 PyTorch 训练模型，那么对 **分布式数据并行 (Distributed Data Parallel, DDP)** 和 **完全分片数据并行 (Fully Sharded Data Parallel, FSDP)** 一定不会感到陌生。这两种方式都遵循经典的 **单程序多数据 (SPMD)** 模型：系统中的每一个进程都执行完全相同的脚本，各自独立控制绑定的加速器，并通过 `AllReduce` 等集合通信原语保持同步。
> If you train PyTorch models, you are likely familiar with **Distributed Data Parallel (DDP)** and **Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP)**. Both follow the **Single Program, Multiple Data (SPMD)** model, wherein every process executes an identical script, controls its accelerators continuously, and synchronizes via collectives like `AllReduce`.
这种模型逻辑直接、易于理解，但在算力集群规模呈指数级扩展时，却会撞上一道道难以逾越的高墙：
> While this model is straightforward, it encounters limitations at scale:
* **数据中心网络带宽瓶颈**：在单个加速器 Pod 或节点内部，依托专用超高速互连总线的组内通信成本极低；但一旦通信跨越数据中心网络，带宽就会断崖式下跌 (例如，TPU v5p 芯片内部互连带宽高达 1,200 GB/s，而跨数据中心网络带宽仅有约 6 GB/s 左右) 。由于 SPMD 模式下每个训练步都必须等待全局集合通信阻塞同步，当任务跨越多组设备时，单步训练延迟 (Latency) 会急剧攀升。 * **流水线气泡 (Pipeline Bubbles)**：在流水线并行模式下，模型的不同层被切分部署在不同的设备上，通过拆分微批次 (Micro-batch) 依次前向和反向传播。这导致许多设备在等待上游输入或下游梯度时不得不处于闲置状态，从而严重拉低了系统的整体吞吐量。 * **强化学习训练循环效率低下**：在基于强化学习的后训练 (Post-training) 阶段，工作流往往由采样器 (Sampler) 、奖励模型 (Reward Model) 以及策略训练器 (Trainer) 共同构成。如果按照传统串行方式运行，在某个组件执行时，其他大部分核心计算资源都只能被动空转等待。
> * **Datacenter Network Bottlenecks:** While intra-group communication over fast interconnects is cheap, crossing the datacenter network introduces severe bandwidth constraints (e.g., TPU v5p chips get 1,200 GB/s internally, but only ~6 GB/s across the datacenter network). Because every step blocks on collectives, step times inflate rapidly as jobs span more groups. > * **Pipeline Bubbles:** In pipeline parallelism, models are split across devices running smaller micro-batches, leaving some devices idle while waiting for inputs and reducing overall throughput. > * **Inefficient RL Loops:** Reinforcement learning post-training involves samplers, reward models, and trainers. Running these sequentially leaves major components idle while others execute.

item.title: Reason Machines 开源专为 AI 智能体设计的 Git 服务器 Aspen
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-10/Reason-Machines-开源专为-AI-智能体设计的-Git-服务器-Aspen/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-10/Reason-Machines-开源专为-AI-智能体设计的-Git-服务器-Aspen/
item.description:
随着编程智能体等 AI 应用的爆发式增长，成百上千个 AI 智能体同时高频提交代码，导致传统 Git 服务器因单仓库锁排队和重复打包历史而频繁遭遇性能瓶颈。针对这一痛点，Reason Machines 正式开源了专为 AI 智能体打造的轻量级 Git 服务器 Aspen。Aspen 借鉴了 OpenAI 内部系统 Pando 的架构理念，颠覆性地将写入粒度从“单仓库”拆解为“单分支”，结合单二进制 Rust 架构、PostgreSQL 元数据与 S3 兼容对象存储，在单台 8 核服务器上实现了高达每秒 567 次持续推送的强悍吞吐量。该项目的开源为解决 AI 规模化编码中的版本控制基础设施瓶颈提供了全新的开放式解决方案。
---
## 核心内容摘要
> ## Summary
Reason Machines 正式发布了开源 Git 服务器 **Aspen**，专门用于从容应对高并发的 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 流量。当成百上千个自主运行的智能体试图同时推送代码更新时，传统 Git 服务器往往会因全局排队写入仓库、以及每次拉取都需要重新打包历史记录而沦为严重瓶颈。Aspen 针对 OpenAI 的 *Pando* 架构进行了一套独立的开源实现，将写入扩展粒度由“单仓库”彻底解耦为“单分支”。Aspen 采用 Rust 语言编写，以单一独立可执行文件的方式分发；它将分支历史路由至 PostgreSQL (或 SQLite) 中管理，并将 Git 数据包无缝写入对象存储，在官方基准测试中展现出惊人的性能表现——单台 8 核服务器即可支撑每秒 567 次的高速持续推送。
> Reason Machines has released **Aspen**, an open-source Git server designed specifically to handle high-frequency AI agent traffic. Traditional Git servers bottleneck when hundreds of autonomous agents attempt to push updates simultaneously because they queue repository writes and re-pack history for every fetch. Aspen provides an independent open-source implementation of the architecture described in OpenAI’s *Pando*, scaling writes per branch rather than per repository. Written in Rust and distributed as a single binary, it routes branch history through PostgreSQL (or SQLite) and packs to object storage, achieving impressive self-reported benchmarks such as 567 sustained pushes per second on an 8-core server.
---
## 极速速览 (TL;DR)
> ## TL;DR
* **架构设计**：采用单个 Rust 二进制文件构建。分支由 PostgreSQL (或 SQLite) 进行轻量管理，Git 数据包 (Pack) 则直接保存在兼容 S3 的对象存储中。 * **部署方式**：支持本地秒级启动 (`aspen dev`)、Docker Compose 一键部署，或通过 Helm 与 Terraform 云端编排交付。 * **性能表现**：推送到不同分支的操作互不阻塞、完全并发，代码拉取操作能高效复用已存储的数据包。 * **主要优势 (官方报告)**：在单台 8 核服务器上，能连续 5 分钟稳定保持每秒 567 次的高频推送。 * **局限性与不足**：当前处于 Pre-alpha 初期阶段，尚未发布正式版本；主干分支 (`main`) 的写入仍受限于约每秒 4 次，且目前暂未提供完整的 Web 管理界面。 * **核心总结**：Aspen 创新地通过单分支原子写入机制打破了传统单仓库推送的性能天花板，尽管它目前仍处于早期探索与开发阶段。
> * **Architecture:** A single Rust binary. Branches are managed via PostgreSQL (or SQLite), while Git packs live in object storage (S3-compatible). > * **Deployment Options:** Run locally (`aspen dev`), via Docker Compose, or through Helm and Terraform clouds. > * **Performance:** Pushes to different branches never block each other, and fetches efficiently reuse stored packs. > * **Pros (Self-Reported):** Sustained 567 pushes per second for 5 minutes on a single 8-core server. > * **Cons & Limitations:** Pre-alpha status with no official releases yet, landing on `main` is limited to ~4 per second, and a complete web UI is currently missing. > * **Bottom Line:** Aspen eliminates the per-repository push ceiling via per-branch writes, though it remains in early pre-alpha development.
---
## 什么是 Aspen？
> ## What is Aspen?
Aspen 是一款可私有化自托管的 Git 服务器，其核心创新在于将写操作的并发能力按“单个分支”而非“整个仓库”进行水平扩展。它通过标准的 HTTPS 和 SSH 协议与常规 Git 客户端通信，将底层的原始 Git 数据包存入兼容 S3 的对象存储中，同时在 PostgreSQL 中以极轻量的结构记录并维护各分支的历史演进。
> Aspen is a self-hostable Git server that scales writes per branch rather than per repository. It communicates using standard Git protocols over HTTPS and SSH, storing raw Git packs in S3-compatible object storage while keeping branch histories lightweight inside PostgreSQL.
---
## 传统 Git 服务器为何难以招架 AI 智能体？
> ## Why Classic Git Servers Struggle with AI Agents
AI 编程智能体通常每隔几分钟就会高频推送一次代码变更，并紧接着触发持续集成 (CI) 流水线。据 [Reason Machines](https://reasonmachines.com/blog/aspen) 介绍，传统的 Git 服务器在处理并发推送时，会将针对同一代码仓库的所有推送请求排进全局锁队列中，形成严重的共享瓶颈；并且每当收到客户端的拉取请求时，服务器都需要动态重新打包生成全新的 packfile。这种机制导致服务器在面对成百上千个并发客户端时，工作负载急剧恶化、扩展能力严重受限。
> AI coding agents push code changes every few minutes, triggering continuous integration (CI) pipelines immediately afterward. According to [Reason Machines](https://reasonmachines.com/blog/aspen), classic Git servers queue all concurrent pushes to a single repository into a shared bottleneck and construct fresh packfiles for every incoming fetch request. As a result, server workloads scale poorly as client counts grow.
当 [OpenAI 遭遇这道同样的扩展壁垒](https://openai.com/index/scaling-git-at-openai/) 时，他们自主研发了内部系统 *Pando*，成功将代码推送的中位数延迟降低了近 5 倍，如今每天支撑着数 PB 级的高峰数据流量。Aspen 的底层架构设计正是直接取材于这一工业级突破。
> When [OpenAI faced this exact scaling barrier](https://openai.com/index/scaling-git-at-openai/), they engineered *Pando*, which reduced median push latency by nearly 5x and now handles petabytes of daily traffic. Aspen directly models its architecture on this design.
---
## Aspen 的底层运作原理解析
> ## How Does Aspen Work?
Aspen 大胆打破了传统 Git 服务器始终恪守的两项底层设计假设：

item.title: Lovable 构建实时服务以集中化数据权限架构
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-10/Lovable-构建实时服务以集中化数据权限架构/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-10/Lovable-构建实时服务以集中化数据权限架构/
item.description:
在现代全栈与 AI 应用开发中，传统客户端直连数据库虽然上线初期简便，却极易造成权限难以管控和网络负载暴增等隐患。知名 AI 代码生成平台 Lovable 近日全面上线了自研的实时服务 Lovable Realtime，正式将前端监听彻底从客户端 Firestore 直连剥离，转向由 Go 语言编写的集中式实时权限与数据分发架构。这一新系统在承载超过 200 万峰值并发订阅的同时，无缝打通了 Firestore 与 Google Cloud Spanner 双数据库，并依托数据去重与增量更新机制，奇迹般削减了 97% 的网络传输负载。Lovable 在短短 40 个工作日内完成核心建设并通过影子流量零故障平滑上线，为构建兼具毫秒级实时性与严苛权限隔离的大规模企业级架构提供了极佳范例。
---
## 核心摘要：自研服务破解实时权限难题
> ## Summary
随着自研实时服务 **Lovable Realtime** 的全面部署，Lovable 成功将前端架构彻底移出了 Firestore 体系。该服务采用 Go 语言构建，旨在集中管理用户鉴权并提供高效的实时数据分发。在支撑超过 200 万峰值并发订阅的严苛场景下，这套全新架构无缝整合了来自 Firestore 与 Google Cloud Spanner 的异构数据，并在后端统一执行严密的安全权限控制。凭借高效的数据去重机制、增量差异更新 (Delta-based Updates) 以及稳妥的灰度发布策略，Lovable 在未发生任何用户侧故障或性能回退的前提下，惊人地将应用程序传输负载降低了 97%。
> Lovable successfully migrated its frontend away from Firestore with the full deployment of **Lovable Realtime**, a custom Go-based service designed to centralize authorization and real-time data delivery. Reaching over 2 million peak concurrent subscriptions, the new architecture integrates data from both Firestore and Google Cloud Spanner while applying robust, backend-enforced permissions. Through efficient deduplication, delta-based updates, and strategic rollout methods, Lovable achieved a dramatic 97% reduction in application payloads without encountering user-facing incidents or performance regressions.
---
## 集中化权限管控与实时数据流
> ## Centralizing Permissions and Live Data
此前，[Lovable](https://www.unite.ai/lovable-acquires-sutro-company-behind-the-slang-programming-language/) 的部分功能高度依赖浏览器端的 Firestore `onSnapshot` 监听器来获取实时数据变动。在旧架构下，浏览器会直接拉取完整的文档快照，这迫使 Firestore 的安全规则必须复刻 Go API 复杂的权限模型。这种模式给数据安全治理带来了巨大隐患：只要开发人员在文档中新增一个字段，就极易意外将敏感数据暴露给用户的浏览器端。此外，Firestore 的安全规则无法直接跨库查询 Spanner 中的数据，这也给管理通过跨域身份管理系统 (System for Cross-domain Identity Management, SCIM) 同步的企业级工作区带来了巨大的技术阻碍。
> Parts of [Lovable](https://www.unite.ai/lovable-acquires-sutro-company-behind-the-slang-programming-language/) previously relied on browser-based Firestore `onSnapshot` listeners for real-time updates. Under that legacy architecture, the browser received entire documents directly, forcing Firestore security rules to mirror the Go API's complex permissions model. This design inadvertently exposed data governance risks: simply adding a field to a document could accidentally expose sensitive data to the user's browser. Furthermore, Firestore rules could not query Spanner data, creating severe hurdles for managing enterprise workspaces synchronized through SCIM.
为了攻克这些痛点，Lovable 在 Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) 上专门构建并运行了一套自研的 Go 微服务。该服务的核心架构具备以下四大关键特性：
> To solve these challenges, Lovable engineered a custom Go service running on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). The service's core architecture features:
* **多路复用 WebSocket 连接 (Multiplexed WebSockets)**：每个浏览器标签页仅需建立一条独立的 WebSocket 连接，即可在其上多路复用并承载各类数据的实时订阅。 * **精简高效的数据管道 (Streamlined Data Pipelines)**：借助变更数据捕获 (Change-Data-Capture, CDC) 机制，实时将来自 Firestore 和 Spanner 的变更通道数据导入高性能消息总线 NATS。 * **智能增量计算 (Smart Computations)**：订阅服务在内存中动态重算数据视图，利用 `xxh3-128` 算法计算哈希值，且仅在计算结果发生实质性改变时，才向下游推送必要的增量差量数据。 * **响应式鉴权机制 (Reactive Authorization)**：系统将鉴权视为一种独立的响应式数据源，一旦用户权限发生变动，便能立即触发最新的数据视图重算，从而将不必要的无效权限计算大幅削减了约 84%。
> * **Multiplexed WebSockets:** Each browser tab opens a single WebSocket connection, multiplexing various data subscriptions over it. > * **Streamlined Data Pipelines:** Change-data-capture feeds channel updates from Firestore and Spanner into NATS, a high-performance message bus. > * **Smart Computations:** Subscriptions recompute views, calculate `xxh3-128` hashes, and transmit only the necessary deltas when outputs change. > * **Reactive Authorization:** Authorization is treated as an independent reactive data source, allowing permission modifications to instantly trigger fresh data evaluations—slashing unnecessary permission recomputations by roughly 84%.
---
## 影子流量保驾护航：实现零故障平滑灰度上线
> ## Shadow Traffic Validated the Rollout
为了确保新老架构平稳过渡，Lovable 率先在影子模式 (Shadow Mode) 下对新服务进行了严格的验证测试：前端浏览器端会并行执行全新的代码执行路径，但在后台默默丢弃返回的负载数据，仍然以旧版 Firestore 的数据源进行页面渲染。这一前瞻性策略帮助工程师团队精准捕获并修复了一系列棘手的边界隐患，例如集群部署引发的客户端重连风暴、错误类型误判以及数据传输包尺寸超限等问题。
> To ensure a seamless transition, Lovable initially tested the service in shadow mode, allowing the frontend to exercise the new code paths while safely discarding payloads and rendering from legacy Firestore sources. This practice helped uncover and resolve edge cases like deployment-induced reconnect storms, misclassified errors, and payload limits.
借助功能开关 (Feature Flags)，新服务的流量在短短数天内从 1% 稳步提升至 100% 全量覆盖，全程未出现任何性能倒退或用户感知的线上事故。为了妥善应对具有长连接粘性的 WebSocket 连接并消除可能的重连尖峰，Lovable 专门设计了基于连接数的动态负载均衡、精细的自动弹性伸缩指标以及客户端状态指纹校验机制。值得一提的是，整套复杂的核心基础设施从零搭建仅耗费了 40 个实际工作日，这在很大程度上得益于集成测试环境中全自主 AI 编程智能体 (Coding Agents) 的强大助推。
> Using feature flags, availability was gradually ramped up from 1% to 100% of users over several days with zero regressions or user-facing incidents. To handle sticky WebSocket connections and prevent reconnection surges, Lovable implemented connection-based balancing, autoscaling metrics, and client-side state fingerprints. Notably, the core infrastructure took just 40 hands-on working days to build, heavily accelerated by coding agents operating within an integrated testing environment.
---
## 生产环境收益与未来应用生态扩展
> ## Production Results and Potential App Support
在为期 30 天的生产环境运行监控中，Lovable 记录到的硬核数据充分印证了这套新架构的极致效率：
> During a 30-day measurement period, Lovable’s production metrics highlighted the extreme efficiency of the new architecture:
* **网络负载大幅缩减 (Payload Reduction)**：生产环境累计产生了 26.1 亿次数据补丁帧传输。如果传输传统的全量快照，网络数据总量预估将达到 40 TB；而在数据去重与增量流式传输技术的加持下，实际传输的数据包总体积被骤降至仅 1.11 TB——**负载压缩率高达 97%**。 * **超低端到端延迟 (Latency)**：从底层数据库完成数据写入，到准备好发送给客户端的输出帧，系统测得的处理耗时仅为 66 毫秒 (p50 分位) 和 249 毫秒 (p99 分位)。
> * **Payload Reduction:** Generated 2.61 billion data/patch frames. While full snapshots would have totaled an estimated 40 TB of data, deduplication and delta streaming reduced actual transmitted payloads to just 1.11 TB—a **97% reduction**. > * **Latency:** The interval between a database write and an outgoing frame being ready registered at 66 milliseconds (p50) and 249 milliseconds (p99).
展望未来，Lovable 正在积极开发领域事件原语 (Domain-Event Primitives)，并探索将这套成熟的实时服务封装为平台内置能力，直接开放给在其平台上构建的各类第三方应用。这一潜在的演进方向将把企业级的后端控制权限与实时数据视图无缝赋能给用户构建的应用程序，从而重塑现代 AI 应用的实时协作体验。
> Looking ahead, Lovable is actively developing domain-event primitives and exploring the possibility of packaging the real-time service as an internal capability for apps built directly on its platform. This potential evolution would bring enterprise-grade, backend-controlled permissions and live data views to customer-created applications.

item.title: Agentic AI 将在撞上智能之墙前先撞上基础设施之墙
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-10/Agentic-AI-将在撞上智能之墙前先撞上基础设施之墙/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-10/Agentic-AI-将在撞上智能之墙前先撞上基础设施之墙/
item.description:
当前行业关于 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 的争论大多聚焦于模型能否可靠规划、自主纠错等算法“智商”层面，但真正决定智能体能否走出实验室、迈向万级规模化落地的，却是底层的工程基础设施与单机经济账。与单轮“即问即答”的传统对话模型不同，AI 智能体在漫长的多轮工具调用与外部接口等待期间，必须让昂贵的 GPU 显存全程驻留巨大的键值缓存 (KV Cache)；即便显卡在等待期毫无计算负载，显存也无法释放，直接导致单机并发容量断崖式暴跌。再叠加串行工具调用带来的累加延迟以及层层放大的隐性重试风暴，大规模运行智能体的服务成本将迅速攀升到不可承受的天价。要想跨越这堵高耸的“基础设施之墙”，不能坐等基座模型自我进化，而必须通过并发工具调用、将会话时长纳为核心容量指标，以及实现显存换入换出与分页缓存等务实工程突破来重塑基础设施。
---
## 核心内容摘要
> ## Summary
关于 AI 智能体未来走向的讨论，大多聚焦在模型本身的智能与能力上限——比如它能否可靠地制定计划、能否在犯错后自我纠错、能否做出靠谱的自主决策。然而，真正决定智能体能否实现规模化落地的致命瓶颈，其实是底层基础设施与单机经济账 (Unit Economics)。与“一问一答、用完即走”的简单对话聊天机器人不同，AI 智能体必须维护一个漫长而活跃的会话；在此期间，即便利存等待外部工具或第三方 API 响应而毫无计算负载，也必须持续霸占昂贵的 GPU 显存来保存键值缓存 (KV Cache)。这种显存锁定，再加上串行执行带来的累加延迟以及层层放大的隐性重试循环，在规模化部署时会引发不可承受的服务成本。要想攻克这堵“基础设施之墙”，不能指望只等前沿基座模型变得更聪明，而是需要依靠务实的工程手段，例如工具并发执行、精细化会话生命周期管理以及优化上下文缓存架构。
> While the debate around Agentic AI often centers on intelligence and capability—such as planning, error recovery, and autonomous decision-making—the true bottleneck to scaled deployment is infrastructure and unit economics. Unlike simple conversational chatbots, AI agents maintain active sessions that consume high-value GPU memory (KV cache) even while waiting on external tool calls or APIs. Combined with sequential execution bottlenecks and compounding retry loops, this creates an unsustainable serving cost at scale. Overcoming this "infrastructure wall" requires practical engineering solutions, such as concurrent tool execution, intelligent session duration management, and optimized context caching, rather than relying solely on frontier model improvements.
---
目前关于 AI 智能体发展方向的大多数探讨，几乎都在围绕“模型能力”打转：大模型究竟能否制定出周密的计划？执行受挫时能否自我纠错？涉及关键后果的真实行动，我们敢不敢放手交给它去操作？
> Most of the argument about where AI agents are headed is an argument about capability. Can the model plan reliably? Can it recover from its own mistakes? Can it be trusted with an action that has consequences?
这些确实是亟待攻克的真问题。但它们并不是决定未来几年智能体能否实现大规模落地的决定性因素。因为有一道更加迫近、到来速度更快的硬约束正在逼近：在推理服务架构中，承载智能体运行的单机经济效益极为尴尬；更棘手的是，大家梦寐以求想要赋予智能体的种种强大能力，反而在以同等幅度加剧这种尴尬。
> Those are real questions. They’re also not the ones that will decide whether agents get deployed at scale over the next few years, because there’s a nearer constraint and it’s arriving faster. Agents are economically awkward to serve, and the awkwardness grows with exactly the capabilities everyone wants to add.
---
## 聊天机器人与智能体属于截然不同的计算负载
> ## A Chatbot and an Agent Are Different Workloads
传统的对话式请求本质上是一次性的单程往返。用户输入提示词，大模型吐出 Token，连接随即关闭。作为系统架构师，你可以对多请求进行批量处理 (Batching)，可以复用公共前缀缓存，并且用一个简单的吞吐量数字就能算清系统的服务容量。
> A conversational request is one round trip. Prompt in, tokens out, connection closed. You can batch it, cache the prefix, and reason about throughput with a single number.
但智能体请求却是一个复杂的持续会话 (Session)。它往往需要发起工具调用，然后原地等待；读取返回的结果后，再思考下一步动作，接着调用下一个工具，历经数轮周折之后才最终给出答案。即便是完成一项中等难度的任务，通常也需要反复调用六到八次大模型，而两次调用之间往往穿插着漫长的等待。
> An agent request is a session. It calls a tool, waits, reads the result, decides what to do next, calls another tool, and eventually answers. A modest task might be six or eight model invocations with waiting in between.
两者之间的根本差异与模型“聪不聪明”毫无关系，却深刻影响着工程实现。在各个步骤交替的间隙，智能体必须持续维持上下文状态——包括历史对话记录、各个工具的返回结果以及逐步累积的推理过程。在服务后端，这些会话状态全部以 [KV 缓存 (KV Cache)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.06180) 的形式驻留在昂贵的 GPU 显存中；只要会话尚未结束，这部分显存就必须全程被其霸占，哪怕智能体在此期间花费了数秒钟仅仅是在傻傻等待某个外部第三方 API 的响应。
> That difference matters for a reason that has nothing to do with intelligence. Between steps, the agent is holding state — the conversation, the tool outputs, the accumulated reasoning. On the serving side that state lives in GPU memory as [KV cache](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.06180), and it occupies memory for the entire duration of the session, including the seconds the agent spends waiting on an API that isn’t you.
因此，衡量推理系统承载能力的度量单位，不再是传统的“每秒请求数 (Requests Per Second, RPS)”，而是变成了“显存常驻并发会话数”。在同一套硬件配置上，一套原先可以游刃有余地支撑每秒上千次常规对话请求的推理系统，在面对智能体会话时，可能仅仅并发几十个会话就会将显存彻底吃饱瘫痪。
> So the unit of capacity stops being “requests per second” and becomes “concurrent sessions resident in memory.” A system that comfortably served a thousand conversational requests per second may serve a few dozen concurrent agent sessions on the same hardware.
---
## 漫长的等待，才是最昂贵的成本开销
> ## The Waiting Is the Expensive Part
这里暴露出了一个令人极其难受的工程特性：在发起外部工具调用的过程中，智能体本身其实处于静止状态。此时既没有生成任何 Token，也没有消耗任何算力。然而，GPU 显存却依然被死死占用着——因为如果将这段上下文从显存中驱逐出去、等响应回来后再重新计算一遍，其代价甚至比一直霸占显存还要高昂。
> Here’s the uncomfortable property. During a tool call, the agent is doing nothing. No tokens are being generated. No compute is being consumed. The GPU memory, however, is still occupied, because evicting and recomputing that context would cost more than holding it.
这就导致了极其荒谬的资源浪费：你机房里最昂贵顶级的 GPU 算力硬件，在很多时刻竟然只是在为一次正在等待数据库返回查询结果的请求干坐着“占座”。
> Your most expensive hardware is reserved for a request that is, at that moment, waiting on a database query.
在传统的分布式系统中，这类问题早在很多年前就已经有了标准解法：工作线程在发起 IO 请求后立刻释放硬件资源，待外部响应抵达后再恢复现场继续执行。但在大模型推理场景下，要做到这一点就意味着必须将庞大的 KV 缓存从 GPU 显存换出 (Evict) 到主机内存或本地固态硬盘，并在需要时再换入恢复；而这一数据搬运过程的数据传输开销极为惊人，以至于绝大多数现行系统根本不敢轻易尝试。[针对这一难题的学术与工程研究](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.06865) 目前异常活跃，而它之所以备受瞩目，恰恰是因为这个问题在商业上的代价太高了。
> In conventional distributed systems we solved this a long time ago — you release the resource and pick the work back up when the response arrives. Doing the same for model serving means evicting KV cache to host memory or disk and restoring it, and the transfer cost is high enough that most systems don’t bother. [Research on exactly this](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.06865) is active, and it’s active because the problem is expensive.
---
## 串行执行让问题雪上加霜
> ## Sequential Execution Makes It Worse Than It Needs to Be
目前市面上几乎所有的智能体框架，在执行工具调用时都是按部就班地一条接一条串行推进。大模型先请求查询天气，等待结果返回；接着请求检查日程日历，等待返回；然后再请求搜索航班动态，继续等待返回。
> Nearly every agent framework executes tool calls one after another. The model asks for a weather lookup, gets it, asks for a calendar check, gets it, asks for a flight search, gets it.
但在很多情况下，这三项查询调用之间根本没有任何依赖关系，它们完全可以同时并行触发。如果采取串行执行，整个请求的端到端延迟就是所有调用耗时的简单相加；而如果改为并发执行，总延迟就直接缩减为耗时最长的那一个调用。
> Frequently those three calls have no dependency on each other. They could have run at the same time. Executed sequentially, the latency is the sum. Executed concurrently, it’s the longest one.
这并不是什么仅针对智能体的全新洞见——任何需要在既定延迟预算内调度多个微服务或多模型的系统，都遵循这一基础架构规律：总延迟应当取决于任务依赖图上的最长关键路径，而不是所有步骤的盲目累加。然而，这一规律在智能体场景下之所以显得尤为致命，是因为智能体会话在整个生命周期内都牢牢霸占着 GPU 显存。因此，压缩真实物理时间 (Wall-Clock Time) 不仅能显著改善终端用户的交互体验，更会直接提升单台硬件能够并发容纳的会话数量。
> This isn’t a novel observation about agents — it’s the same structural point that applies to any system running multiple models or services inside one latency budget. Total latency should be the longest path through the dependency graph, not the sum of every stage. The reason it matters more for agents is that the session is resident in GPU memory for the whole duration, so cutting wall-clock time doesn’t just improve the user’s experience, it directly increases how many sessions fit on the hardware.
只要将单次会话的持续时长缩短一半，在完全不更换 GPU 硬件、不对模型做任何改动的前提下，集群的并发承载能力就能直接翻倍。
> Halve session duration and you roughly double concurrent capacity, on the same GPUs, with no model change.
---
## 悄然放大的重试风暴：无人设计的级联灾难
> ## Retries Compound in a Way Nobody Designed
现代智能体框架通常会直接沿用底层 HTTP 网络库的默认重试策略，最常见的默认值便是自动重试三次。
> Agent frameworks inherit retry defaults from the HTTP libraries underneath them. Usually three attempts.
与此同时，大模型本身也会以它特有的方式发起重试。当某个工具返回了不符合预期的无用结果时，具备推理能力的模型往往会自主调整策略，换另一种方式重新尝试——这在本质上同样是一次重试，只不过它是由模型自主推理触发、从未被任何人显式配置过。
> The model also retries, in its own way. When a tool returns something unhelpful, a reasoning model will often try a different approach — which is a retry, just one that nobody configured.
当这两层机制叠乘在一起时，灾难就诞生了：外层被固化了三次网络重试策略，而内层模型又自主思考出三种替代方案并依次重试，最终演变成了一场高达九次的级联重试，而这一切甚至未曾在任何架构设计文档中体现。更致命的是，每一次重试都是一次完整的大模型前向推理调用，需要重新生成大量 Token 并消耗实打实的 GPU 运行时间。
> Stack those and a three-attempt policy wrapped around a model that independently reasons its way into three more approaches is a nine-attempt policy that no one wrote down. Each of those attempts is a full model invocation, with its own tokens and its own GPU seconds.
当底层依赖的某个服务出现性能劣化变慢时，这种隐性放大效应便会将局部的性能抖动直接推向系统性瘫痪；更可怕的是，大模型单次重试所耗费的计算成本，相比于传统 REST 接口重试高出了数个数量级。
> When a dependency slows down, this amplification is what turns degradation into an outage, and it does so at a cost per attempt that’s orders of magnitude above a retried REST call.
---
## “基础设施之墙”的真实模样
> ## What the Wall Actually Looks Like
这堵阻碍智能体落地的硬墙，并不是什么高深莫测的模型能力天花板，而是一个极其现实、甚至有些枯燥的单机经济账问题。正是它，将无数雄心勃勃的 AI 创新项目死死拦截在从“概念验证 (PoC)”走向“生产上线”的关键分水岭之前。
> Not a capability ceiling. Something more mundane: a unit-economics problem that stops projects at the pilot-to-production boundary.
在小规模试点测试阶段，一切看似运转良好：面向十来个内部用户，响应延迟尚可接受，账单金额微不足道。但当业务团队尝试将其推演至一万名并发用户时，测算出的 GPU 显卡采购需求瞬间变成了一个天文数字——这并不是因为模型本身的推理速度太慢，而是因为每一个并发会话在其整个生命周期中都死死咬住显存不放，而这个生命周期的大部分时间，实际上全都在毫无意义地等待。
> The pilot works. It’s ten users, latency is acceptable, and the bill is a rounding error. Then someone models it at ten thousand users and the GPU requirement is implausible — not because the model is slow, but because concurrent sessions each hold memory for their full lifetime, and lifetime includes waiting.
正是在这个测算阶段，无数原本前景广阔、令人兴奋的企业内部原型 Demo，不得不悄无声息地下线夭折。
> This is the stage at which a lot of promising internal demos quietly stop.
---
## 如何打破这堵基础设施之墙？
> ## What Moves the Wall
破局的方法并不神秘玄乎，而且所有的突破口全部集中在底层基础设施的工程改造上，而非等待模型算法本身的突破：
> Nothing exotic, and all of it is infrastructure rather than modelling:
* **并发执行无依赖的独立工具调用**：这是当前无需采购任何新硬件即可立刻兑现的最大性能红利。 * **将会话持续时长确立为核心容量度量指标**：不要再单纯盯着每秒 Token 生成数或 GPU 利用率。真正关键的是状态在显存中的常驻时间有多长，以及当前显存究竟能容纳多少个并发会话。 * **在系统全局统筹重试预算，而非按单次调用孤立设置**：引入全局重试预算上限（例如将重试流量严格限制在总流量的较小比例以内），彻底遏制前文所述的级联指数放大。Google SRE 在[过载处理 (Handling Overload)](https://sre.google/sre-book/handling-overload/) 中的经典工程实践，以及 Envoy 的[重试预算 (Retry Budgets)](https://www.envoyproxy.io/docs/envoy/latest/configuration/http/http_filters/router_filter) 机制，都早已在传统微服务体系中验证了这一思路。 * **将逻辑推理与具体执行解耦分离**：调用高参数量的顶尖大模型负责制定高阶规划，而将机械繁琐的中间执行步骤交由轻量级的小模型完成。智能体日常处理的大多数常规操作，根本不需要劳烦前沿基座模型。 * **大幅降低上下文显存换出与恢复的成本**：积极引入量化 KV 缓存、[分页注意力 (PagedAttention)](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/) 机制，并为处于空闲等待状态的会话开辟低成本换出通道。这正是当下大模型推理服务工程领域最具创新价值的前沿阵地。
> * **Execute independent tool calls concurrently:** The largest single win, available today, requiring no new hardware. > * **Treat session duration as the capacity metric:** Not tokens per second. Not GPU utilization. How long state stays resident, and how many sessions fit. > * **Budget retries across the system rather than per call:** A global cap — retries as a small percentage of total traffic — prevents the compounding described above. Google’s SRE practice on [handling overload](https://sre.google/sre-book/handling-overload/) and Envoy’s [retry budgets](https://www.envoyproxy.io/docs/envoy/latest/configuration/http/http_filters/router_filter) both implement this idea outside the AI stack. > * **Separate reasoning from execution:** A large model to plan, a much smaller one for the mechanical steps. Most of what an agent does doesn’t need a frontier model. > * **Make context eviction cheap:** Quantized KV cache, [paged attention](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/), and offload paths for idle sessions. This is where the most interesting serving work is happening right now.
---
基座模型的能力必定会持续演进，这一点毋庸置疑。但 AI 智能体最终究竟能够成长为支撑千行百业的底层基础设施，还是沦为停留在实验室里的昙花一现的 Demo，取决于那些看似并不起眼、缺乏光环的工程底座——我们究竟能否高效承载这种“一边漫长等待外部响应、一边持续占用昂贵显存”的全新计算负载；我们能否彻底摆脱为串行调用的机械累加买单，转而只为关键路径上的最大耗时付费。
> The models will keep improving. That part looks reliable. Whether agents become infrastructure or stay demos depends on something less glamorous — whether we can serve a workload that holds expensive memory while it waits, and whether we stop paying the sum of a sequence when we could be paying its longest path.
*针对上述最后一点——即在单一延迟预算内并发执行具备依赖关系的模型调用，作者在论文 [《机器学习系统中模型路由的异步推理图执行》 (Asynchronous Inference Graph Execution for Model Routing in Machine Learning Systems)](https://doi.org/10.14445/22312803/IJCTT-V72I10P101) (发表于《国际计算机趋势与技术期刊》72(10)，2024年10月) 中提出了底层的执行模型。关于将生成式模型深度整合至受严格延迟约束的决策系统的更多实践，可参阅 [《大模型增强型交易与决策平台：弥合生成式智能与金融决策系统》 (LLM-Augmented Trading and Decision Platforms: Bridging Generative Intelligence with Financial Decision Systems)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18223142) (发表于《信息系统工程与管理期刊》11(1s)，2026年)。*
> *I published the execution model underlying that last point — concurrent execution of dependent model calls within a single latency budget — in [“Asynchronous Inference Graph Execution for Model Routing in Machine Learning Systems”](https://doi.org/10.14445/22312803/IJCTT-V72I10P101), International Journal of Computer Trends and Technology 72(10), October 2024. On the integration of generative models into latency-bound decision systems specifically, see [“LLM-Augmented Trading and Decision Platforms: Bridging Generative Intelligence with Financial Decision Systems”](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18223142), Journal of Information Systems Engineering and Management 11(1s), 2026.*
---

item.title: Google 开源 Elephant-Goldfish 插件：专为 AI 编程智能体打造的“规范优先”设计与审查架构
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-09/Google-开源-Elephant-Goldfish-插件-AI-智能体规范优先审查架构/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-11-09/Google-开源-Elephant-Goldfish-插件-AI-智能体规范优先审查架构/
item.description:
在大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 辅助编程的时代，开发者经常遭遇“上下文崩溃”以及 AI 盲目编写代码、产生低质“垃圾代码 (AI slop)”的痛点。针对这一普遍难题，Google 正式开源了其内部数千名工程师深度使用的 Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) 插件。该方案确立了“规范优先 (Spec-First)”的核心机制：要求负责维护全局记忆的“大象”智能体在写代码前先撰写详尽的技术规范，随后由完全处于零上下文记忆状态的“金鱼”子智能体发动多轮严苛的无偏见交叉审查。这一插件的开源不仅将错误扼杀在方案构思阶段，更为业界构建可靠、可审计的工业级 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 软件工程体系提供了标准范式。
---
Google 正式开源了专为 AI 编码智能体量身打造的设计与审查层——[Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) 插件](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model)。其核心理念十分简单直接：**强制要求智能体在动手写代码前必须先撰写详尽的技术规范，随后派出没有任何对话历史记忆的全新子智能体，对这份规范展开无死角的审视与挑刺。**
> Google has open-sourced the [Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) plugin](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model), a design-and-review layer tailored for AI coding agents. The core philosophy is simple: **force an agent to write a specification before it writes code, and then have fresh subagents with zero conversation history attack that spec.**
据 Google 介绍，[其内部已有数千名工程师在使用该工具](https://egm.dev/)，以便尽早发现错误的设计假设——直接在初始的 Markdown 文件中将隐患扼杀在摇篮里，而不是等到后续提交代码合并请求 (Pull Request, PR) 时才仓促返工。
> According to Google, [thousands of its engineers use it](https://egm.dev/) to catch wrong assumptions early—directly in a Markdown file rather than down the road in a pull request.
---
## 📌 内容速览
> ## 📌 Summary
* **项目定位：** 一款基于 Apache 2.0 协议开源的插件，包含 7 项核心技能、9 种审查员角色设定、6 大头脑风暴视角以及 5 个递进审查阶段 (该插件不包含任何模型权重，底层大语言模型由宿主智能体提供)。 * **核心工作流：** 负责长会话上下文的“**大象 (Elephant)**”在不编写任何代码的前提下草拟技术规范，而无状态的“**金鱼 (Goldfish)**”子智能体则对其展开严苛尖锐的多角度审查。 * **平台兼容：** 适用于任何能够派生全新独立子智能体的宿主平台 (Harness)，包括 Antigravity、Claude Code (2.1.271+)、Claude Cowork、Codex 以及 ChatGPT，直接复用开发者现有的模型额度。 * **实测性能：** 真实环境基准测试展现出稳健的执行能力 (例如 Codex 0.163.0 成功按顺序调度了 15 位原生全新上下文审查员，并在 573.13 秒内顺利通过了 2 项实测)。 * **核心结论：** 它提供了一种在真正写代码前强制执行独立审查的坚固机制；尽管其伴随着较高的 Token 消耗，且在特定宿主环境下偶尔会出现微小的上下文隔离波动。
> * **What it is:** An Apache 2.0 open-source plugin consisting of 7 skills, 9 reviewer personas, 6 brainstorm lenses, and 5 review stages (no model weights included; your agent provides the LLM). > * **Core Workflow:** The **Elephant** (long-session context) drafts the spec without writing code, while stateless **Goldfish** subagents aggressively review it. > * **Compatibility:** Works across harnesses that can spawn fresh subagents, including Antigravity, Claude Code (2.1.271+), Claude Cowork, Codex, and ChatGPT, leveraging your existing model quota. > * **Performance:** Real-world benchmark tests show solid execution (e.g., Codex 0.163.0 successfully completed 15 native fresh-context reviewers in order; 2 live tests passed in 573.13s). > * **Key Takeaway:** It offers a robust way to enforce independent reviews prior to coding, though it comes with heavy token consumption and occasional context-isolation hiccups on certain hosts.
---
## 什么是 Google 的 Elephant-Goldfish 模型插件？
> ## What is Google’s Elephant-Goldfish Model Plugin?
EGM 是一款基于 Apache 2.0 协议开源的工程化插件，内含结构化技能集、审查员角色预设以及严苛的文档交付标准。需要特别指出的是，它**绝非**一款全新的基础语言大模型。
> EGM is an Apache 2.0 plugin comprising structured skills, reviewer personas, and strict document standards. It is **not** a new foundational language model.
该插件背后的方法论源自 [Dave Rensin 的深度博文](https://medium.com/@drensin/elephants-goldfish-and-the-new-golden-age-of-software-engineering-c33641a48874)，核心围绕“大象 (具备长期记忆)”与“金鱼 (无状态的即时子智能体)”的协同机制展开。尽管 [Google 开源博客 (Google Open Source blog)](https://opensource.googleblog.com/2026/10/introducing-elephant-goldfish-model-plugin.html) 将其盛赞为遏制 AI“劣质代码 (slop)”及解决会话上下文崩溃的一剂良方，但该代码仓库的 README 中也明确注明：它[并非 Google 官方正式支持的商业化产品](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model)。
> The underlying methodology stems from [Dave Rensin’s essay](https://medium.com/@drensin/elephants-goldfish-and-the-new-golden-age-of-software-engineering-c33641a48874) regarding elephants (long-term memory) and goldfish (stateless, transient subagents). While the [Google Open Source blog](https://opensource.googleblog.com/2026/10/introducing-elephant-goldfish-model-plugin.html) promotes it as a remedy for AI "slop" and session context collapse, the repository's README notes that it is [not an officially supported Google product](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model).
---
## Elephant-Goldfish 的工作流程是如何运转的？
> ## How Does the Elephant-Goldfish Workflow Work?
整个工作流紧紧维系在两类核心角色之上：
> The workflow hinges on two primary actor types:
1. **大象 (The Elephant)：** 长期存活的主会话，负责维护整个项目的宏观背景与历次技术决策。它全权负责撰写技术规范，但**绝对不编写任何一行代码**。 2. **金鱼 (The Goldfish)：** 完全无状态的临时子智能体，*仅*审查规范草案本身及文档中明确引用的关联文件，从而杜绝先入为主的偏见，确保客观公正的审计。
> 1. **The Elephant:** A long-running session that maintains project context and historical decisions. It drafts the specification but writes **no code**. > 2. **The Goldfish:** Stateless subagents that review *only* the draft and explicitly referenced files, ensuring an unbiased audit.
其[核心循环 (core loop)](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/blob/main/docs/getting_started.md)主要通过三大核心斜杠指令驱动：
> The [core loop](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/blob/main/docs/getting_started.md) operates via three primary commands:
* `/egm-brainstorm`：理清底层业务逻辑，并启动拥有 6 种视角的“金鱼机群” (涵盖 YAGNI 原则、Token 成本、用户体验 UX、系统迁移、可观测性与技术债务)，最终输出一份清晰的 `concepts_brief.md` 概念简报。 * `/egm-draft`：将上述概念简报逐节细化，转化为存放于 `docs/designs/` 目录下的正式技术设计方案。 * `/egm-review`：正式拉起多阶段的金鱼交叉审查流程。
> * `/egm-brainstorm`: Clarifies the underlying idea and runs a 6-lens Goldfish swarm (covering YAGNI, token costs, UX, migration, observability, and tech debt) to output a `concepts_brief.md`. > * `/egm-draft`: Translates the brief into a formal design document under `docs/designs/`, section by section. > * `/egm-review`: Executes the multi-stage Goldfish review process.
此外，系统还提供了一个 `/egm-drift-report` 指令 (官方推荐每周运行一次)，用于对比实际代码库与已审批的技术规范之间的差异，有效防止软件架构随迭代逐渐“偏航走样 (architectural drift)”。
> Additionally, a `/egm-drift-report` command (recommended weekly) compares the actual codebase against the approved specification to prevent architectural drift.
---
## 五阶段“金鱼审查”到底是如何开展的？
> ## What Happens in the 5-Stage Goldfish Review?
这套[审查技能 (review skill)](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/blob/main/skills/egm-review/SKILL.md)会强制技术规范依次通过五个严谨且环环相扣的审查阶段：
> The [review skill](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/blob/main/skills/egm-review/SKILL.md) forces specs through five strict, sequential stages:
1. **宏观初审 (Initial Zoom Out)：** 从顶层软件架构视角全面评估整份设计文档的合理性。 2. **理解力测试 (Comprehension Test)：** 指派一只金鱼子智能体用自己的语言复述设计方案。如果复述出现偏差，则说明文档存在歧义与表达不清之处。 3. **挑刺审查 (Critic Review)：** 调度设计、架构及代码风格等多位审查员，全力搜寻边缘用例 (Edge Cases)、潜在盲点与架构断层。 4. **阶段复查 (Intermediate Zoom Out)：** 在初步问题完成修复后，重新对整体架构的一致性进行二次校验。 5. **落地就绪度评估 (Implementation Readiness)：** 严密核对文件路径、数据结构以及函数签名等具体实现细节是否万无一失。
> 1. **Initial Zoom Out:** Evaluates the entire document from a high-level architectural perspective. > 2. **Comprehension Test:** A Goldfish subagent paraphrases the design. If the paraphrase is flawed, the documentation is flagged as ambiguous. > 3. **Critic Review:** Design, structural, and style reviewers actively hunt for edge cases, blind spots, and architectural gaps. > 4. **Intermediate Zoom Out:** Re-verifies the architecture after initial fixes are applied. > 5. **Implementation Readiness:** Validates file paths, data structures, and function signatures.
*注：每个阶段最多仅允许复审一次。审查发现的问题会被严格划分为**阻断项 (Blocker)**、**重大缺陷 (Major)** 或 **轻微修饰 (Nit)**。如果宿主环境缺乏子智能体调度工具，EGM 将直接中止运行——在同一上下文中进行的自审查绝不能被算作真正的金鱼审查。*
> *Note: Each stage permits a maximum of one re-audit. Findings are rigorously categorized as **Blocker**, **Major**, or **Nit**. If a host environment lacks subagent tooling, EGM halts—a same-context review does not qualify as a Goldfish review.*
---
## EGM 支持哪些编程智能体？
> ## Which Coding Agents Does EGM Support?
项目最初推出时[仅支持 Antigravity](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/10/26/google-elephant-goldfish-model-plugin/)，但根据最新的[宿主环境指南 (harness guide)](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/blob/main/docs/harnesses.md)，目前支持阵营已拓展至 Antigravity CLI 与 App、Claude Code、Claude Cowork、Codex、ChatGPT、omp 以及 Muse。其中，在 Antigravity CLI、Claude Code 和 Codex 上，端到端自动化测试固件均能无障碍顺利通过。
> Initial rollouts featured [Antigravity-only support](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/10/26/google-elephant-goldfish-model-plugin/), but the current [harness guide](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/blob/main/docs/harnesses.md) has expanded to include Antigravity CLI and App, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Codex, ChatGPT, omp, and Muse. Automated end-to-end fixtures pass cleanly on Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, and Codex.
* **Claude Code：** 要求[版本不低于 2.1.271](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/blob/main/docs/claude.md)。审查员被严格限制仅能使用 Read、Grep 和 Glob 工具，且本地的 `CLAUDE.md` 文件会被显式排除在上下文之外。 * **实测记录：** 详实的基准测试运行记录证明了其在工业场景中的可用性： * *Antigravity CLI 1.4.5：* 16 位原生审查员依次完成了所有阶段的审查任务。 * *Codex 0.163.0：* 15 位原生审查员在 573.13 秒内完成了 2 项真实用例测试。 * *Codex CLI (v0.1.0 ZIP)：* 仅耗时 482.30 秒便成功通过了完整的测试套件。
> * **Claude Code:** Requires [version 2.1.271 or later](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/blob/main/docs/claude.md). Reviewers are restricted to Read, Grep, and Glob tools, with local `CLAUDE.md` files explicitly excluded from their context. > * **Test Records:** Concrete benchmark runs showcase real-world viability: > * *Antigravity CLI 1.4.5:* 16 native reviewers executed all stages sequentially. > * *Codex 0.163.0:* 15 native reviewers completed 2 live tests in 573.13s. > * *Codex CLI (v0.1.0 ZIP):* Full test suite completed successfully in 482.30s.
---
## EGM 与 Spec Kit、Kiro 及 Superpowers 相比有何不同？
> ## How Does EGM Compare with Spec Kit, Kiro, and Superpowers?
| 特性 (Feature) | Google EGM | GitHub Spec Kit | Kiro Specs | Superpowers | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **定位类型 (Type)** | 插件 (技能集 + 角色设定) | 工具包 + Specify CLI | 智能体 IDE/CLI/Web 功能 | 技能集插件 | | **开源协议 (License)** | [Apache 2.0](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/blob/main/LICENSE) | [MIT](https://github.com/github/spec-kit) | 商业闭源 ([定价方案](https://kiro.dev/pricing/)) | [MIT](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) | | **工作流 (Workflow)** | 头脑风暴、起草规范、审查、架构漂移报告 | 架构规范宪章、细化说明、方案规划、任务拆解、编码实现、收敛校验 | 需求分析、方案设计、任务管理 | 头脑风暴、方案规划、子智能体构建、测试驱动开发 (TDD)、代码审查 | | **规范是否由全新上下文子智能体审查？ (Spec Reviewed by Fresh-Context Subagents?)** | 是，编码前历经 5 个独立审查阶段 | 未公开 | 未公开 (*需求分析*阶段通过) | 否 (全新子智能体在编码阶段按任务逐一审查代码) | | **宿主环境支持 (Harness Support)** | Antigravity、Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT 等 | GitHub Copilot 及其他智能体 | 仅限 Kiro | 列出支持 16 种宿主工具 | | **环境安装 (Setup)** | 插件直接安装 | 依赖 Python 3.11+ 与 `uv` | 注册 Kiro 账号 | 插件直接安装 | | **使用成本 (Cost)** | 插件免费 + 宿主模型推理额度 | 工具包免费 + 宿主模型推理额度 | 需按月订阅 | 插件免费 + 宿主模型推理额度 |
虽然 Spec Kit 和 Kiro 在各个阶段之间高度依赖人工审查检查点，而 Superpowers 则主要将子智能体隔离机制应用于实际编码实现阶段，但 EGM 最具标志性的特征，是在动笔写代码之前，就对*技术规范*展开极其严苛、零上下文历史的独立审查。
> While Spec Kit and Kiro rely heavily on manual human checkpoints between phases, and Superpowers delegates subagent isolation primarily to the implementation phase, EGM's defining characteristic is its aggressive, zero-context review of *specifications* prior to writing code.
---
## 核心要点总结
> ## Key Takeaways
* **重架构而非重权重：** EGM 本质上是一套组织与流程型插件，而非底层大语言模型——它巧妙依靠“大象”起草规范，并调度“金鱼”子智能体展开全面审查。 * **强制“规范优先”：** 每一份软件设计文档在生成哪怕一行代码之前，都必须严格通过 5 个零上下文的独立审查阶段。 * **生态覆盖广泛：** 全面支持主流生态，在 Antigravity、Claude Code、Codex 以及 ChatGPT 等平台上均可顺畅运行。 * **经过验证的可靠性：** Codex 实测记录展现出完整闭环，成功端到端连续轮转了 15 位全新上下文审查员。 * **仍有改进空间：** 在某些特定命令行界面 (CLI) 下，审查员隔离机制偶尔会微量泄露宿主指令，且整体 Token 开销相对较高。
> * **Architecture over Weights:** EGM is an organizational plugin, not an LLM—relying on the "Elephant" to draft specs and "Goldfish" subagents to review them. > * **Spec-First Enforcement:** Every design document must clear 5 zero-context review stages before any code is generated. > * **Wide Ecosystem Reach:** Fully functional across platforms like Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex, and ChatGPT. > * **Proven Reliability:** Codex test runs successfully cycled through 15 fresh-context reviewers end-to-end. > * **Room for Improvement:** Reviewer isolation can occasionally leak host instructions on specific CLIs, and token overhead is substantial.
---

* **官方链接：** [GitHub 代码仓库](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model) | [项目官网](https://egm.dev/) | [Google 开源博客文章](https://opensource.googleblog.com/2026/10/introducing-elephant-goldfish-model-plugin.html) * **加入社区：** [Twitter](https://x.com/intent/follow?screen_name=marktechpost) | [15 万+ 成员的 ML SubReddit 社区](https://www.reddit.com/r/machinelearningnews/) | [订阅周刊](https://magic.beehiiv.com/v1/f5e63dd4-5653-4f09-83e2-321a8b1ba526?email={{email}}) | [Telegram 频道](https://t.me/machinelearningresearchnews) * **商业推广与合作：** [与我们取得联系](https://promotions.marktechpost.com/)，在平台上展示您的 GitHub 仓库、Hugging Face 主页或新产品发布。
> * **Official Links:** [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model) | [Project Website](https://egm.dev/) | [Google Open Source Blog Post](https://opensource.googleblog.com/2026/10/introducing-elephant-goldfish-model-plugin.html) > * **Join the Community:** [Twitter](https://x.com/intent/follow?screen_name=marktechpost) | [150k+ ML SubReddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/machinelearningnews/) | [Newsletter](https://magic.beehiiv.com/v1/f5e63dd4-5653-4f09-83e2-321a8b1ba526?email={{email}}) | [Telegram Channel](https://t.me/machinelearningresearchnews) > * **Promotions & Partnerships:** [Connect with us](https://promotions.marktechpost.com/) to feature your GitHub Repo, Hugging Face Page, or Product Release.
